name: Harriet Hageman | Wyoming Congresswoman
subject: Here's why I'm with Nancy
body:
| | | |
---
# OFFICIAL ENDORSEMENT LETTER
---
|
---
| | Hi, Peter. I know a thing or two about what it takes to win an at-large congressional seat far from the D.C. swamp.
We brought _**integrity**_ back to Wyoming in 2022, and now it's your turn to help make history in Alaska for my friend and Alaska's lieutenant governor, Nancy Dahlstrom.

Hard working Alaskans deserve a Congresswoman who will actually get things done and not play political theatre. I know a lot about that too. **_[**_Will you step forward with a contribution of just $5 or maybe more to make it happen?_**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=a8e41c2a970b44d0a291e2cbf8512a7f&_m=1ec989aa68744cc5afef8cd514bd4fb0&_e=pcOJyPSdPdopRd5rRSCFnjh3gczbJCiz0hnBAXzdXqL3wadfQgS1FfoMFMSLA3SzQxJkI9jVd4Sezy1DrY5abH92h6YmTU4RtEaLa3N-S0_N-RKn-M3KU5mTolcf0cmR47NuELtAxGl8mZxhbdsDo_uX7lFCxa2PsSKMIWwIxvWw44W3b2d-P_umbMUvamv7sfSVS7m4gVgvI15-Mxw1DUbs3pjrhPuP7esASgj6Wkj4IPF4InX8PrjaVQzz4o9iIGCrLv7cC92G2dOvSRYc6GabwmzFKNxO7ST2y3XkEvkvqDeKuOjkRdZxSA0wytwj)_**
---
[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=a8e41c2a970b44d0a291e2cbf8512a7f&_m=1ec989aa68744cc5afef8cd514bd4fb0&_e=pcOJyPSdPdopRd5rRSCFnjh3gczbJCiz0hnBAXzdXqL3wadfQgS1FfoMFMSLA3SzQxJkI9jVd4Sezy1DrY5abH92h6YmTU4RtEaLa3N-S0_N-RKn-M3KU5mTolcf0cmR47NuELtAxGl8mZxhbdsDo-ynJGfCxQ4YhsybRkIqPqlJosbF860uJkvMW3gWO8rKDXS7aKeu_ODumfJIWlb7xkS4JUqCLh0js41qd_x-U_2NLy9SbmiQudB7HrERNyRkSqVAVPhnYR0vUx4VdhBnMIIy3JMgcZRi4FDawE3Y-Ncstr0Hz-J0a2aR78GGJnMz)

Wyoming and Alaska both have statewide Congressional seats, and take it from a ranch girl, they are a different kind of animal. It takes a special kind of in-touch representative like Nancy to truly understand the variety of needs, perspectives, dreams and concerns of people from the city to the countryside and everywhere in between. Alaska needs a fresh, conservative voice like Nancy's to bring back **energy production** and **unleash the wild and wonderful Alaskan spirit** that federal overreach has tried to extinguish over the past four years. I endorsed Nancy because we need more conservative women in Congress with the heart of a champion and the grit to get the job done. _**[_**Will you step up today with a personal, grassroots contribution of $5 to help elect a proven fighter?**_](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=a8e41c2a970b44d0a291e2cbf8512a7f&_m=1ec989aa68744cc5afef8cd514bd4fb0&_e=pcOJyPSdPdopRd5rRSCFnjh3gczbJCiz0hnBAXzdXqL3wadfQgS1FfoMFMSLA3SzQxJkI9jVd4Sezy1DrY5abH92h6YmTU4RtEaLa3N-S0_N-RKn-M3KU5mTolcf0cmR47NuELtAxGl8mZxhbdsDozSz4RqtPWagzW20CGBx8jngDg7Lt-gudD0VBB50PPZEzmKcQRpGWYfQnRU4L-6AU732TR_uIsyEOiw049IbniUITmVl65_p5spkfmsonUvoUsKdGtvuExwJxpyWbJATTqsocOZ0wiGY-t3OOI7iBmsMhbIR4mdYIOu484Gt2FOm)**_ For America,**Harriet Hageman** _Congresswoman At Large, R-WY_

Today is the 59th anniversary of the Voting Rights act of 1965 , Team. It's fitting that today the Governor who signed Minnesota's new Voting Rights Act into law earlier this year became a candidate for Vice President of the United States.
Minnesota is a state that has long lead the fight for voting rights -- pioneering things we still fight for nationwide, like same-day registration on Election Day. Gov. Walz has signed new law after new law, guaranteeing voters access to the ballot and expanding the way voters cast their ballot in our elections, working to make every voice heard.
The Harris-Walz ticket's pro-voter, pro-democracy, and pro-election positions couldn't be clearer. Now it's up to groups like ours to make sure every voter is informed about what's at stake in this upcoming election and which candidates are in favor of voting rights while others may want to restrict our right to vote.
Pitch in $25 or whatever you can today to help register, educate, and turn out as many pro-voting rights voters as possible this November >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=080624_3&amount=25]

Gov. Walz's mission echoes ours: “ We know that the more people vote, the more representative our state government can be ”. He said this while signing Minnesota's Democracy for the People Act , continuing on with " This bill will strengthen our democracy, allow future voters to get engaged early, and keep our campaigns honest and fair. ”
In fact, the Harris-Walz duo may be the most pro-voting rights ticket we've seen in recent history. Voters deserve to know where every candidate stands on policies and initiatives related to voting, given the rhetoric we've seen the last few years.
We need to amplify that message. There's little time left before voting begins, so we've already begun educating voters across the country about the consequences of this election and which candidates stand up for ballot access and the right to vote.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90348087/490239427/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjNiMTk0N2ZmLTU1NTQtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=FDotKyZeQNYYRSBIiGN0qeuoW_FOj5Ni2KKpEwpvGM0=&emci=8dce8e31-2a54-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=3b1947ff-5554-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=8431045)

Peter, Fifty-nine years ago today, the Voting Rights Act was signed into law — the crown jewel of the Civil Rights Movement. Ever since then, it has been a shining pillar of our democracy and what we can accomplish through collective action. **But over the last couple of decades, anti-democracy forces have worked hard to dismantle this critical source of voting protection. ** In 2013, the Supreme Court’s ruling in _Shelby County_ dismantled a key portion of the Voting Rights Act, effectively nullifying Section 5 — a critical tool to prevent states with a history of racial discrimination from enacting discriminatory voting laws. Under Section 5, these states needed to receive preclearance before passing new election laws. Eliminating this check opened the door for a new wave of voter suppression laws across the country — and it took only minutes following the _Shelby_ decision for gerrymandered legislatures across the country to start passing those discriminatory laws. **We have a tough fight ahead of us. Yet we are not without hope, Peter. ** Just last year, in _Allen v. Milligan_ , the Supreme Court rejected Alabama Republicans’ attempt to further undermine the Voting Rights Act when it refused to invalidate Section 2 of the VRA, a provision that prohibits lawmakers from diluting the political power of communities of color. By rejecting Alabama’s effort to cut away at Section 2, the Court helped ensure that the Voting Rights Act will continue to serve as an important tool to make our democracy more representative, and more fair. Still, too many politicians across the country are determined to hold on to unearned power by restricting and undermining the right to vote. **So today, as we honor the history of the Voting Rights Act, we recommit ourselves to the fight for fair maps and free elections. Join us.** Thank you,
Marina Marina Jenkins

name: AOC
subject: My endorsement
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
I wanted to check in because there’s a lot going on.
Today is a really big day: Vice President Kamala Harris has picked Governor Tim Walz to serve as her running mate, and her Vice President once we work to elect her in November.
**I think he’s a great pick.**
**I think Kamala Harris and Tim Walz together show what America is actually about, and what our values _actually_ are.**
We’re in a very exciting moment, but **our success is directly correlated to how we translate this energy into actions.**
[We have a real fight at the top of the ticket that is worth fighting for. Will you split a $5 contribution between our campaign and Team Harris/Walz to power our fight for the White House _and_ the House of Representatives?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240806-2.t38mns&refcode=em20240806-6955-P_FND_SPL_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6955%2E2526796%2EnERAhE)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240806-2.t38mns&refcode=em20240806-6955-P_FND_SPL_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=6955%2E2526796%2EnERAhE)**
Tim Walz served in the National Guard and was a teacher, football coach, and union member for 20 years before ever running for office. He then served in the House of Representatives for over a decade, and a lot of folks that served with him all say the same thing: **he’s a good, genuine guy who understands the needs of working families,_just like the one he grew up in_.**
As Governor, Tim had to work with a razor-thin majority in the Minnesota State Legislature, and **he used that tiny majority to govern boldly** : he signed universal school lunch into law, banned conversion therapy, protected abortion rights on the state level, lowered the cost of insulin to $35 per month, and ushered in many other powerful policy changes to serve everyday people.
Not a lot of leaders do that. When a governor only has a handful of votes for a majority, they are often advised to stay small and play it safe. To not rock the boat.
**But Tim didn’t do that**. He understands that true leadership is about using the power we have, when we have it, to change everyday life for the better. **He swung for the fences to fight for rural families, women, LGBT+ communities, civil rights, and more**. He governed in a way that said: “When you’ve got the keys, drive as far as you can.”
We are in a time where Republicans have tried to stoke stereotypes and divisions between rural America, urban America, and suburban America that simply aren’t true. I have had the privilege of seeing and connecting with many of you across the country, and the big thing that you learn is: **most of us want the same things**.
We care about putting food on our tables. About being able to afford rent, or a mortgage, or medicine. We care about being able to go to the doctor without going bankrupt, and having the right to choose over our own bodies.
We don’t get progress on anything if Donald Trump and JD Vance are within any shot of the presidency this November.

clean_body: I wanted to check in because there’s a lot going on. Today is a really big day: Vice President Kamala Harris has picked Governor Tim Walz to serve as her running mate, and her Vice President once we work to elect her in November. I think he’s a great pick. I think Kamala Harris and Tim Walz together show what America is actually about, and what our values actually are. We’re in a very exciting moment, but our success is directly correlated to how we translate this energy into actions. Tim Walz served in the National Guard and was a teacher, football coach, and union member for 20 years before ever running for office. He then served in the House of Representatives for over a decade, and a lot of folks that served with him all say the same thing: he’s a good, genuine guy who understands the needs of working families,just like the one he grew up in. As Governor, Tim had to work with a razor-thin majority in the Minnesota State Legislature, and he used that tiny majority to govern boldly : he signed universal school lunch into law, banned conversion therapy, protected abortion rights on the state level, lowered the cost of insulin to $35 per month, and ushered in many other powerful policy changes to serve everyday people. Not a lot of leaders do that. When a governor only has a handful of votes for a majority, they are often advised to stay small and play it safe. To not rock the boat. But Tim didn’t do that. He understands that true leadership is about using the power we have, when we have it, to change everyday life for the better. He swung for the fences to fight for rural families, women, LGBT+ communities, civil rights, and more. He governed in a way that said: “When you’ve got the keys, drive as far as you can.” We are in a time where Republicans have tried to stoke stereotypes and divisions between rural America, urban America, and suburban America that simply aren’t true. I have had the privilege of seeing and connecting with many of you across the country, and the big thing that you learn is: most of us want the same things. We care about putting food on our tables. About being able to afford rent, or a mortgage, or medicine. We care about being able to go to the doctor without going bankrupt, and having the right to choose over our own bodies. We don’t get progress on anything if Donald Trump and JD Vance are within any shot of the presidency this November. It’s official. I am the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate here in Michigan.
I’m so grateful to Michigan voters for entrusting me not only with this honor, but also the responsibility of keeping Michigan and this U.S. Senate seat blue in November. I will not let you down.
Because there is just too much at stake:
Whether Michigan is a place where anyone can get in and stay in the middle class.
Whether our granddaughters have fewer rights than their grandmothers.
Whether the American experiment of a multi-racial, multi-ethnic democracy continues.
And whether Michigan contributes to keeping the White House, and making history.
So you can bet I will be working harder than I ever have before. I know that we can win this, but it will take all of us. My team has set a rather ambitious $100,000 General Election Founding Donor Goal for the next week so that we can hit the ground running in the sprint to the general election. Will you split a donation of $20 or more between Tim Kaine and my campaign tonight and become a General Election Founding Donor? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-slotkin]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
DONATE $20 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-slotkin?express_lane=true&amount=20]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-slotkin?express_lane=true&amount=50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-slotkin?express_lane=true&amount=100]
OTHER [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-slotkin]
In short: the real race begins now. We’re up against Donald Trump and Mitch McConnell’s handpicked candidate, Mike Rogers, a man who has shown that he’ll say or do anything to get elected.
He has co-sponsored bills that would not only ban abortion nationwide but threaten in-vitro fertilization and birth control. He supported privatizing Social Security and Medicare. After 20 years as a politician, Rogers left Michigan for good. He cashed in on his D.C. connections to make millions by helping Chinese tech companies, giving them access to the United States. And in doing so, increased his net worth by as much as 2,000%. Then he bought a mansion in Florida and two yachts. He is only moving back to Michigan to run for the Senate.
It’s clear: Mike Rogers is only looking out for himself.
I will be working to make sure every Michigan voter understands just how bad Mike Rogers would be for Michiganders if elected to the Senate, but we need resources to start immediately holding him accountable to his record.
Will you become a General Election Founding Donor today and chip in $20 to Tim Kaine and my campaign? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-slotkin]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-slotkin]
Thank you for your support,
Elissa Slotkin

We protected access to abortion, capped the cost of insulin, cut taxes for working families, established universal background checks for gun purchases. It's common-sense stuff. But these other guys are just plain weird. Donald Trump and JD Vance are selling a twisted version of freedom where far-right extremists can invade your doctor's office. **For Immediate Release:** August 6, 2024| [Info@DravesforCongress.com](mailto:Info@DravesforCongress.com) **Mary Draves Concedes Republican Primary For Michigan’s 8th Congressional District** **Midland, MI-** Tonight, the Mary Draves campaign concedes in the Republican primary election for Michigan's 8th Congressional District. “I want to express my deepest gratitude to everyone who supported our campaign. From those who volunteered countless hours, to those who contributed financially, and to every single person who lent their voice to our cause—thank you. I am extremely proud of this campaign. We have built a powerful movement in a very short time and I am honored to have garnered so much support from every corner of this district. I want to thank my family, especially my husband Todd, for their love and support. Running for office is a team effort, and no candidate could ask for a better team than the one I have had by my side. To all the dedicated staff and volunteers who believed in this campaign, your passion and hard work have been the backbone of our efforts, and your commitment to what you do continues to inspire me. Throughout this campaign, the voters in the 8th Congressional District have been bombarded with $2 million dollars of Junge's parents trust fund on misinformation about me. I hope that for all future elections, each one of us will make sure to know what is right and truthful about the candidates we are supporting and that those seeking office take it upon themselves to act in ways that are dignified, constructive, and credible. My whole life and career have been dedicated to service and I will continue to serve the 8th district to create opportunities for those who live here just like I do. What we have built on this campaign will not go away. Our message to Mid-Michigan is this: _we will continue to fight for you, continue our work to deliver results, and lead with integrity in whatever capacity that may be."_
###

The Ten Commandments uphold traditional values and celebrate the family unit as foundational to society, helping children navigate life's challenges with confidence and grace. | | That's why I'm excited to introduce my brand new kids book, The 10 Commandments for Kids book. In the March Primary Peter Hernandez and Zoe Lofgren finished in the Top 2 and are competing for Congressional District 18 in the November election. Finishing third in March was Democrat Charlene Nijmeh who managed to take 11% of the vote away from Lofgren.

Charlene Nijmeh is the Tribal Chairwoman of the Muwekma Ohlone Tribe. The Ohlones are the indigenous people of the Bay Area who are frustrated trying to work with Lofgren. The longtime congresswoman is the subject of intense criticism for her mistreatment of the Tribe, which includes a January 2023 conversation on Capitol Hill in which Lofgren demanded that Tribal Chairwoman Charlene Nijmeh sign away a vast swath of the Tribe's rights and freedoms in exchange for legislation that would correct the federal government's mistake.
On Tuesday, August 13th, on the steps of San Jose City Hall, the Muwekma Ohlone Tribe will hold a rally at NOON, where Tribal Chairwoman Charlene Nijmeh will endorse Republican Peter Hernandez over Zoe Lofgren. This endorsement is a game changer for the Hernandez Campaign.
If you caught [Channel 7 ABC News on Monday](https://8d469khbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XrEEroxi_D7hvGJxtDMoeEswDQvAzoqtQdXLh7gIjAsR8QpwXFHpLzLlCTPPqeDUYf-Gzws190Jnx5oO2E9xQYcwVL4ND5g8RvB5-yN2OSHAercBM2z-FdQeIQq8-201--nZd6Hq76Ik6GxnSIFiIsTZBFuePG5lFKY5zQUxnB6k7gXl7mzqb7ht7gsyUuzo&c=pC9Vqll_LGuYzxxxzWMkgnqSRhIddyHVWzJjGlKpm8DfeAyoRY_FCA==&ch=lO1i38jZaJhBtaFNoeM_1NbVSNffMf9-vwpYeGJIqhYz9j64q5qY6Q==), you saw Tribal Chairwoman Nijmeh lead a caravan of horses over the Golden Gate Bridge as they start their trek to Washington, DC to protest Lofgren. Riding on horseback, the Tribe will be participating in the August 13th rally at Noon.
Please join us at San Jose City Hall and participate in this event! If you can participate in this rally let us know by clicking the RSVP button below so we can provide instructions on where to meet, plus send an invitation to a Zoom meeting the evening before so you can ask questions and get more info on this event from Peter Hernandez.
This will be a fun event!! Come out and support Peter Hernandez and invite your friends!!

| | | Dear Friend,Our culture so closely resembles that of ancient Corinth, it's as if Paul wrote his epistle of **[1 Corinthians](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)** directly to us.Like the Corinthians of old, we find ourselves in a society that is obsessed with self, indifferent (if not antagonistic) to God, confused about love, in denial of the Resurrection, and riddled with sin. Unfortunately, these sins have influenced the church today, just as they influenced the Corinthian church.How should we respond? Paul gives instructions in 1 Corinthians, and I invite you to study this pivotal book in a **[new Dallas Theological Seminary free online course](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._vUjyQy3MgUSQ3Me5-jQ)** , taught by Dr. Tom Constable. subject: Babylon Bee’s Bold Plan to Get the Last Laugh
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.secureandprosper._4nEf5pNGdw)
---
|
---
Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](http://trk.secureandprosper.)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It 's clear to us that what the censors want is submission. **They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and stop fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They're asking us if we're willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](http://trk.secureandprosper.-aC7f3Q)**** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](http://trk.secureandprosper._RoCHUZyw60SDcF4tg)
---
Thanks for standing with us. We will continue to stand with you. Sincerely,Seth Dillon
CEO, The Babylon Bee

We're in a moment of national reflection.

Friend,

We're in
a moment of national reflection.

And for
many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our
culture, institutions, and daily lives-for the better.

Friend,
over the past year, I wrote my new book, Right Wing Revolution,
as a guide for a return to an America where…

We
are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief
in American Greatness.

We
have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our
Constitution.

We
have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide
spiritual renewal.

We
trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have
to lock our doors at night.

We
bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with
integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for
all Americans.

Can I
send you a FREE copy of Right Wing Revolution to read today? All
I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning
Point USA-and our critically important work to make kids LOVE
AMERICA again.

Make
your gift & get your FREE book

Friend,
I'm proud to say that Right Wing Revolution is like NO OTHER book
you've read from the Right before:

It's
NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between
Left and Right.

It's
NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I
do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.

It's
NOT a call for our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference -
instead, its focus is on how all Americans can improve our
country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving
ourselves.

I want to
get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as
possible-which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover
edition for FREE.

All I ask
for in return is your gift of ANY amount to help support Turning
Point USA's work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again!

Make
your gift & get your FREE book

In this
defining moment for America's future, let's come together in a
spirit of FREEDOM and with a firm belief in AMERICAN GREATNESS to
find all that's possible in the days ahead.

Thank YOU
for your patriotism, moral courage, and continued support of
Turning Point USA.

For
America,

Charlie
Kirk
Founder &
CEO
Turning
Point USA

## Pakistani Charged in U.S. Assassination Plot
Federal authorities have charged a Pakistani national with alleged ties to the Iranian government with attempting to [hire hitmen to assassinate](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOqzAQRb_G7hzZg8FO4eI1dHntlmiAIcyuwQhPstq_XyX11ldX5-h83IYbcub9_h83SrKUASfhJw3RBAN-8HpOCxFQoym5AI1tQudArwk8WhrBXucltrOfwOM1REcTdBO1DjUnsOBttMFZ27bxYsexm5cGfXDXGDEob2lmKefls_AuKy35pzzpvExl0zmtIkdVzT8FvYJeVlo559emoD_p_sgoXHYF_VQep5gRRTJVBb2PzkPjzIFfXAV3NnziboSpmkc1WCvWyvv7blCEtkMU9PpM8_HNOXPtXm73DfnN0_JnmGeC3wAAAP__DjxmxQ) former President Donald Trump and other U.S. politicians.According to the unsealed criminal complaint, Asif Merchant, who faces one count of murder for hire, allegedly [arrived in the U.S.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFvpDAQBeBfYzojewyYLVycdKLba05RSjTgASYxNsLOrvbfR6RO9Yr3ik_v_T7ekQPH9R_u5MqSRpwLP2jspZXQjE3l3UIEZCpy2oJRxnYaqs016AmMNhp90_aqVcsNLKC26tbNbT9V7EBBo3pltVJt29dqmjq_GGysvvU9WtEo8lzSWX8kjmWjJbzSg856TnsV3FbKkYX5I2AQMOA0R3rmek1XLWB4-y9gOPCTc8HIMmLhFDHIecNzJS8xBLryCKlIzBlz5oiFpL9mXpbzaz8EDLmk8yXMwF6Yv1pDp62ybXU6fzw5BM7dBV135PADK7--9HDwHQAA__-k9GmX) in June to recruit people to carry out the assassination plot. The person he contacted was an FBI confidential informant.Merchant [was arrested in July](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2u2zAMhZ9G3hhI9I-cQUMXb7drx4CJ6Gu2smRITIK8feHOXQh8IHAOvvPr6_ZFkiR__6Sdg67lRg-VF99m8IDDbehiWJmR-46D89jb3k8Ouy1gRI5uvo6js-QmP9ydx3Udr5F9HKPrJKDFwc7WO2vHcb7Y-32Ka0-Dd9d5Jm8Gy1G01MvvIlk3XtOnvLheHmXvUthUj2b6HwYXg0v-HKXp-TK4nMEGFzufZzK4PBtkfjeDy0F_pCllgUwqJVOCt-gGKtxAC0ilDFqF40mbVIZNdOd84lGUswql9AFqjVqTTMqg9bkfUHTjCs8GR0mi8hDKDVaOZ21XQzzekpK06RT73knSPxH976qvgH8DAAD__2l6fEo) after finalizing plot details and giving cash to undercover agents. There is no known connection between Merchant and the recent attempt on Trump's life.
## Harris Taps Walz for VP
Vice President Kamala Harris selected [Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FutDAQBOCnMZ2RvTYYChd_Q3d_mxItsBybGHMyDlby9BGp0400xXzz9hgfyIHj8z_u5PN6jDhnvmjspJNgR1stfiUCMhV57cAo41oN1eZ7BDJNaw3B3IDuV9X0K-plsk7PC-iKPSiwqlNOK9U0Xa2mqV1Wg9bpvuvQCato4Xyk-v3gmDdaw9dxUarnY6-C33J-ncL8EzAIGEop9Tydkcp59wKGOwoYMu-yYPiW10t-4I4B5YYp8SnTZ4wcn3LHTPK2CBiq5JdX4RD4bG_Ac0cOv4P5z_eXh58AAAD__zrJXCk) to be her vice-presidential running mate on Tuesday, ending speculation about who would join her on the Democratic ticket heading into November's election.Prior to politics, Walz was a high school social studies teacher and football coach. He also served 24 years in the Army National Guard.Walz, [a dark horse candidate](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFuhDAQAF9jOp_M2mBTuEhDd2lTogUv501sjMDilLw-utSpRxqN5uM-3ZETb493zOTrWiZcKl80OWklmMk0wa9EQLoh31rQStu-hSb6TmNvMKjOwKDnsHSz6xSpsNKwKhiwYQ8KjHLKtkp1nbupee7DqtHYdnAOrTCKAtdy3D4LbzXSmr7LRcdtKblJPta6n0K_CRgFjDVS5JReTMAYS6aNnqeAccG8Iz82AaOxblDQyi_MmFBGPA4-5bXLylk-Mf3IzNtGZ6koYGwOH_Ynp8Rn_2p5ZOQ_f1P_HXF5-A0AAP__Y9hgEw), beat out other more high-profile names like Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro and Arizona Sen. Mark Kelly after segments of the left objected to Shapiro's stance on Israel and Kelly's hesitation on pro-union legislation. Walz has also [drawn broad criticism](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvgzAQRn8N3hyZs4OdwUMXtnTtiGxzhmsNRnBNlP76is6dP316T-_jPtwDFVqn97Cg51yHkJgeODhpJZjBiNFnREAt0LcWtNK2a0HMHq1xOaTcoUkqgc4xdq3Ltxhz0FdUgjwoMMop2yp1vbqLirEbsw7Gtjfngm2MwpG47pfPSivPmMurPnC_pLqI4mfm7Wj0WwN9Az3POFMp59ZAP9cFV3weDfTGtUbDTTIt8hnKj9xx-46FUlhlYA7p65AT1n1CmUt9jXLbK-PB51fsftyeVAod3akzLYH-EIL_bfHw8BsAAP__dqFisQ) for his Covid-19 lockdown policies and management of the 2020 riots in Minneapolis. Later in the day, [Walz joined Harris](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LHSnSAQBeCn0W4dQBFuQZHG7k-b0llluWyC4iCjc_P0GVP_5ZmvOef8-pq_kBPv75-4kashz7hWvmi2YEAN89B6F4gU9S05aVQvejNK1UbnvbSodXgptayroXEgtSy6H6Q2QWtq2SmhBmGFkUJobTuxLKMPPQ5GvqxF0wyCPNdcut-Z9xoppE--qHRr3trkYq3H2fQ_GjU1arrvu_tgzPnRRk073WejpsQXPYp1jfAE-IMbJoSIpfAJuHuovMGN6S_gcRAW4B2OyAk9pSMyQsgFaiQuELicFQqm9IGa31QjFZC9MNK-tO1i3VJbnD9uTonP8Vnw3pDT_8b12_sup_4FAAD__9yEdIA) at a political rally in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.
## X Sues Advertisers
Elon Musk's social media platform X (formerly Twitter) [filed a lawsuit on Tuesday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyhCAUheGnwQ4HLyhsQZHGbtOmdBCuuyS47MBVs2-fcevU5xTf_F_X6epiio_bp1vR0pIn5ynuOBmuOahJNcEuiICyQdtpkELqoYPmbpVfJIYB9KyHPgD2Fx-U6byWUpouzE20IEAJI3QnRN-bVszzEBbplO4uxjjNlMAQKZf2O8cH3XFJr7xjaX1em2TvRM_K5AeDkcF4HEdbcCMs9dwZjAlvLjEY163-VP7Lnfdbxcpd2LFQrFgqj-n94nN--UzEH3jw5I66ReKnjgvDxcBgbIoNzyOmFOtwwm6ri-kNoX-r7Bb-AgAA___mPWUG) against the World Federation of Advertisers and several major companies, including Mars and CVS Health, accusing them of unlawfully conspiring to boycott the site and causing it to lose billions in advertising revenue.The lawsuit, filed in federal court in Texas, alleges that [the advertisers acted against their own economic interests](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DGvnDAQBOBfYzqQWcDmChdp3F3alMiH17CJsU9mgdy_f-LVrx2NNJ_mz3N6OoqUlt9uQ8MhT25mOnEaa11DP_WVNwERsKvQtBo62WnVQrWaQQXtVS8f7TjMQ_BqaOUMqHSQHbRyqMiAhF6OUrdSDsPYyNdL-dC5XrePcXRa9BI9cS7N30yJVwzxk08szZy3KpqV-b2L7pcAK8Be19XwisvhiieX7o4AyzivKce8fARYV5jmiALsPXwHxyLASiXAYsyp3o79X_2_dv7EwrRTWurorv0grl1i4nLsXBXj3xfFSLu6hcvmKH6L-Md7TgNfAQAA__9zwWe0) in a conspiracy that violated U.S. antitrust law.X says it has implemented advertiser safety measures similar to other social media platforms, designed to prevent ads from appearing next to inappropriate content.It is seeking unspecified damages and a court order against [continued efforts to withhold ad dollars](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DGPhCAUBOBfgx0GngpvC4pr7PbaKw0C7r6NigHU3X9_8eprpplk8mV-7sPd0kzr49suwZQpDtYVOsKAXHNoh7byZgoBQlMFIzU0otFKQvU0iKixayT64Ebl1KikdN0NQbXovB0rMiCgFSi0FKLrsBbjqPzU2FbLG6LVrBXBU4mpfkVayzNM8yceIdUuLtVsnqVsmTVfDHoG_XmetX1TzFfLoL-2GfQCr1AM-uxi3Pib5z1kvthXTHxMdvWZW89p9Xsu6cMfKe4bn2Lidi1U0p5LlYzfTppnyuoyPRZL85-h_HvIYeA3AAD__9oeYo8).

| Fellow Georgians,
Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler is teaming up with Trump Force 47 for an election integrity training tomorrow, August 8th at 6PM in Lawrenceville.
Poll watchers play a critical role in keeping our elections fair by observing the polls during an election to ensure that all of our laws are being followed by local officials and voters alike. Every precinct in our state needs them, and anyone can sign up to help.
Tomorrow night, the Trump Force 47 team will offer poll watcher training and share other volunteer opportunities - for canvassing, phone banking, and more.

Choosing Tim to be my running mate was not a decision I made lightly -- it was important to me to select a candidate with governing experience and with a proven track record of getting things done on behalf of their constituents. # **Kamala’s VP Pick: The GOP’s Worst Nightmare**
---
| | | | | [ ](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2ue7ko-ead0vc-kyd76rh9/)
---
| | | | Kamala Harris has once again proven she's not here to play by the old rules, and her Vice Presidential pick is the latest testament to that. It's a decision that has the Republicans scrambling, their fury more palpable than ever.
Take Nikki Haley, for instance. Her reaction has been nothing short of a public meltdown. Haley’s pointed critiques and dire warnings about the VP pick sound more like the desperate cries of a politician seeing her party's grip on power slip through her fingers. It's almost as if Harris' choice hit a nerve that Haley didn’t even know she had.
And Haley isn’t alone. Other GOP stalwarts have been lining up to voice their outrage, each trying to outdo the other in their condemnation. They’ve thrown around words like “radical” and “dangerous,” but let's be real - this is more about their fear of a changing political landscape than any genuine concern for the nation’s future.
The Republicans' reactions speak volumes. They see Harris' choice as a formidable challenge, a disruptor of the status quo that threatens their carefully constructed narrative. This is not just about a VP pick; it’s about a seismic shift in the political arena, and they are terrified.
The GOP’s attempt to discredit this choice is as transparent as it is ineffective. Their loud protests only highlight their desperation and unwillingness to adapt to the new political realities. Meanwhile, Harris and her team are demonstrating strategic brilliance, keeping the focus on their vision for the future and forcing the Republicans into a reactive stance.
In a political landscape that’s been dominated by the same old faces and ideas, Harris’ choice represents a refreshing change, a bold step toward the future. And it’s precisely this boldness that has the Republicans so rattled. They can see the writing on the wall, and it spells trouble for their outdated playbook.
So, let them fume and fuss. The more they protest, the clearer it becomes: Kamala Harris’ VP pick is a game-changer, and the GOP knows it. Their outrage is the best endorsement of this decision’s impact and promise. [**_But we can’t let our guard down now. We need to rally behind this momentum and ensure this bold vision for the future prevails. Join us in this crucial battle to stand up for progress and send a powerful message in 2024: it’s time for change, and we’re ready to fight._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2ue7ko-ead0vd-kyd76rh0/)

## Houston Actor Accused Of Murder
A 21-year-old actor once considered a rising Hollywood star has been [accused of murder](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGymzAQheGnER3MsshIFCrSqHPalMyCVrYmAnnE2thvn3Hq25zqFN_8f67zlVJO--03bezkHctMq6QXz7Y1LepZN8EtEKa-YdcbHGAYcMLm7uAS0I72Erlfgh6nJVoTl6lH22szWWqSQ0ANFkwPl3GYOoIRVwLEhftIEJUGDklK7eTOwm86Yv6UF9duLVuT3V3kcajhl0Kv0J_n2T0PkhLo8z0o9IeU-lHoeReuQmnfeBeFfuXMS02S-FDovwqFHux3RoWeVim1pb8pp3ZbQzk553Z71sBVoTd6tBonBDAKfVNdeJwp53SMRmm4bZTyf5_8XOvl8F8AAAD__xH6ars) in Harris County. [Akili McDowell, who starred](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1uhDAQBOCnMZ1Py_JjKFykobu0KdFiL4cVY5_M5n7ePiJ1mmlG-jSar-t8pRBDun3SzlZea57JSXjwPGijsZ3bytsF_FhXbGuDDTQNjlhtFoxh0zCMsLi647rrVx7GYRw6rs3YuSpYBGxhAFND1zfjhaBHR4C4cL0SrKoF9kFyucjGwi861vjODy4Xl_cq2k3kfqjmQ-GkcErvez7krBROp6xwguGMTuHESbgIhbRzEoXTEmIMOR2anOSi6TvEoHfn85Nj1FQKH8JeU_LabVRu7PUzyKb3n-K5KJyqYv39eSpHb1QLt51C_Bsm_9_0sPgbAAD__xQXaq0) in "Billions" and "David Makes Man" and appears in the recent film "The Waterboyz," is charged with killing a 20-year-old man who allegedly attempted to buy drugs from him. McDowell was reportedly known as "the weed man" at his apartment complex. The murder occurred on July 20, but police didn't arrest McDowell until two weeks later. McDowell is being held on a $400,000 bond. Prosecutors [assigned him a public defender](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O6yAQRp8Gd0Qw4L-C4jbuctstrQGGGAUbC5M4eftVUm_7fdLR0fm5zleMKW63_7iSqa-QZ3Q1PmkeeM9Bz7rxxgo_yoaM7EEJpWCEZjEteas0WmiDs8H2fWilGO0Ag-1Cp8cmGhCgxSB6KdpOjRcUHTgUAJZkQBGYFuRjzeVSF6r0wiOkd35Subi8Nskste4HU_8YTAwmtE6qz8Ng2vNRP9M9pshX5_NJKXEshY5Kni9YSjy4y4-tvvmXzNdH8VR43gsu_IxbKPTmG9UzlzvP58bR1Vy4W7DcyDOYZCv1AGPLYGqK8fsZU4pH1zMtbivG9JWsfyd7GvgNAAD__zZfcLg) after he claimed he couldn't afford an attorney.
## Highway Chaos Derails Morning Commute
A bizarre incident shut down the westbound lanes of I-635 in Northeast Dallas for several hours on Tuesday morning. Following a crash, one of the drivers exited his vehicle and [instigated a fight](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOqzAQAL_GdEbL4mAoXLyGLq-9Ei14Hftk4gg7OPn7U66-boqRRpqv63KlEMP99p92NuXl0kJbCScvo9QS1aIaa1awU9ew6TT20Pc4YeONGpVyl2HrJj2NwJpZo1u1Qwtsp4GaYBBQwQi6g8vQTy3BgBsB4sqdI3BCAdtQ0tEWz4VflF18p5OPdkt7E40v5ZFF_0_gLHCutbYuvdSda_4IAucPCpz3ZyxBnuzDFlluB2Uvs3-WLG2qdxnXb-kO5kpvaSlGys1h7KOGGEMetFBw2ynE32j5e8Fp8CcAAP__OY9gkw) with one of the other drivers involved. A bystander tried to intervene but was stabbed by the suspect, who then got into an empty TxDOT vehicle and ran into the employee it belonged to. Yet another bystander [tried to help](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxs0D9vgzAQBfBPY7ZDx9nYMHjowpauHdH5X3DrhAjckH77KlHHzu_pp6f3cZpPnEu-nt_5Em19pHVmX_M9zgMYIDWrJliHYeyaaDtDEqWkkZrFotYsSfUsQ5e6TqJJMbFxo8RESskmW0JSOKDpsNdybBk1eUYiF7vEmITCGHJdt7YuscYH76n8rPe4tX69NMUutd52Id8ETYKm4zjaIzE_Q0ETbzX7EgVNdeOUshc0BS6Fd3hR4DfeF9Cyh78CfN8C17iDK6v_igGK-4S0bnGvUPj6pGgwwD3zoJODMeoBFKIB51gC0-CTGv0QTWg2G25HLiXv2giF5wvn8lpd___wbuk3AAD__8UAco4) after seeing the TxDOT employee get hit, but the suspect entered that person's vehicle and hit him or her with it. Finally, several Good Samaritans were able to [tackle the man](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxsj72O6yAQRp8Gd1jDgMEuKG7jLrfd0hrDOEYiITJsnH37VVJv-_3o6HxdlgulnO7X_3Rj315bWSi09ORllE6iWUwX_QpxUh175VCD1jhht3tLisMazUjKIpKyTrGbwghMatCD7pJHQAMjOAWD1VNPYDEQIK6sNoJNGOCYWjn6tnPjF9Ut_5QnH30oty77vbVHFfqfwFngfJ5nH9Z657O-e4Hz5yJwfkfvAde2lu97lElaPciQS-UoaWt8yHBQ3QXO3eHj40w5p2qdMHC9UcofXvvb_unxNwAA__-qo1zP) and detain him until police arrived. The suspect and three victims were taken to local hospitals.
## Texas Is Third Most Religious State
Texas is the [third most religious state](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQAL8Gd1jLYmNcULyGLq-90lpgSdCROLJJnPz96VJfPdJoNF-n5USlltv5P13ZtVdeF4qtPHmxcpI4LEOXXIA0q46dmlCD1jhjd3FsaDKzVqQwWTQ0jnFUrHLgkXVQuisOAQewMCkYjZ57AoORADGwygRZDMCptHXr24Ubv2jP9b0-eevjeu2qu7R234X-J9AL9Mdx9Ecm-oUCPW2txMoC_Y2PXaCva6Qq0H9EcuNazmV97HKj27fc2yO9BXq0k2TQEG1GafMU5EAzyhCIpBlnFQAGazB1m0v3o9RadjOJAc5XKvWT1f6e9HT4EwAA__8682dQ) in the U.S., after Alabama and Virginia, according to a study by charity directory SmileHub. Using various data sets, such as the U.S. Census Bureau, the U.S. Religion Census, and Google Trends, SmileHub [compared the 50 states](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuwyAQgOGngc3WcZAYDwxdvKVrR-sIZxsJl8hc3PTtq3bu9G-_9H3c5hvlkj_Xd9o5yGupM90lnzz7bujQzU6nECGNRnMwA1qwFkfUWyB0abzAQNFFAxY9ebswguHR-0uKOgcEdOBhMHC52rEnuOKdADGyWQgW5YBTlnr0srHwi9pSvuvJR3-vuy5hE3k0Zd8UTgqntufC2zP29VgVTrHU3-y1SXdwyWuuz9Y1IeGmcDIO9RHS4yuXktt1UA7WnXL5W8v_0DPgTwAAAP__Qk5Vjg) across several categories. Texas leads in faith-based charities per capita and religion-themed Google searches, earning it a first-place ranking in the "Religion-Affiliated Organizations" category and second place (behind North Carolina) in "Religious Interest & Places of Worship." Although denomination didn't factor into the study's rankings, the U.S. Religion Census shows that Southern Baptist is the predominant religious identity in North Texas and the Panhandle, while South and West Texas are predominantly Catholic.

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 8/7/2024
body:
Who is Harris’ VP candidate Tim Walz? A far Left radical, Trump campaign says
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi folks,
This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, August 7, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Who is Harris’ VP candidate Tim Walz? A far Left radical, Trump campaign says](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Where does the selection of Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz as vice president place a possible Kamala Harris-Walz presidential administration on the political spectrum?
It cements it as a [far Left, radical ticket](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), the most radical in the country’s history, several sources in the Donald J. Trump presidential campaign said Tuesday.
“From proposing his own carbon-free agenda, to suggesting stricter emission standards for gas-powered cars, and embracing policies to allow convicted felons to vote, Walz is obsessed with spreading California’s dangerously liberal agenda far and wide,” Karoline Leavitt, the Trump-Vance campaign press secretary, wrote in a statement.
Walz is [soft](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on [crime](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and “loves” China, opposition [research](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) by the Republican Party indicates.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Markets claw back some losses on rebound Tuesday; Dow still down 4.17% for the week](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* After a severe drop, Wall Street experienced a recovery with the Dow Jones Industrial Average rising by 0.76%, the S&P 500 increasing by 1.04%, and the Nasdaq Composite growing by 1.03%. The rebound was led by significant gains in Nvidia and Meta Platforms, though not all tech stocks saw recovery, with Alphabet and Apple continuing to decline.
* The market's downturn on Monday was attributed by financial analysts to a disappointing jobs report and potential inaction by the Federal Reserve. Former President Donald Trump labeled the decline the "Kamala Crash," linking it to Democrat Kamala Harris securing presidential nomination delegates, and argued that his potential presidency would spur significant market growth.
* Despite recent losses, the Dow has grown 11.21% over the past year but remains down by 4.17% for the week, still 2,378.34 points away from its record high.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Judge awards families of loved ones left rotting in funeral home $950M, but getting paid may be another matter](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX 21 NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A Colorado judge ordered the owners of Return to Nature Funeral Home, Jon and Carie Hallford, to pay $950 million to families affected by their mishandling of 190 decaying bodies and distribution of fake ashes.
* The judgment is considered largely symbolic as the Hallfords have been facing financial difficulties for years and did not participate in the civil case hearings.
* In addition to the civil case, the Hallfords are facing separate criminal charges related to their operations at the funeral home located in Colorado Springs.
* The attorneys for Jon and Carie Hallford have not commented on the case, with Jon's representation being handled by the public defender’s office.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Council gives unanimous support to Denver’s plan to spend $3M on youth job program](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Denver City Council approved spending $3 million on the Denver Youth Employment Program, part of a broader $4 million initiative aimed at reducing youth violence and revitalizing the city center.
* The Denver Youth Employment Program, originally launched by former Mayor Michael Hancock, focuses on providing work experience to youth, helping them purchase school supplies, and contributing financially to their families.
* Mayor Mike Johnston’s YouthWorks program targets connecting 1,000 students with summer jobs, offering a $1,000 stipend for completing 100 work hours, as part of his strategy to reduce gun violence by 20% within the year.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[As sentencing approaches on four misdemeanors, ‘J6 Praying Grandma’ prepared for prison](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO SPRINGS GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Rebecca Lavrenz, a 72-year-old from Colorado Springs, faces potential imprisonment following her conviction on four misdemeanor charges for entering the U.S. Capitol during the January 6th rally.
* Lavrenz, who testified that she was motivated by her Christian faith and did not engage in violent or unruly behavior during the incident, expressed a readiness to accept prison if necessary, viewing it as adherence to her religious principles.
* As she awaits sentencing, Lavrenz remains active, speaking at various events across the country, sharing her views on patriotism and faith, and has raised substantial funds for her legal defense.
* Lavrenz’s case has attracted significant attention, adding to her profile as she continues to advocate for what she sees as a fight against the suppression of conservative voices in America.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Two emerge to be selected by vacancy committee to appear on ballot as Democratic candidate for HD19](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A vacancy committee will convene on Thursday to choose a new Democratic candidate for House District 19 after Rep. Jennifer Parenti decided to withdraw from the race, citing the influence of personal agendas and special interests in the legislature.
* Four candidates are in contention: Anil Pesaramelli, a software engineer; James Reed, an IT professional with board leadership experience; Richard Garcia, a longtime educational board member and father of Rep. Lorena Garcia; and Jillaire McMillan, a writer and director of volunteers.
* The chosen candidate will contend against Republican Dan Woog in the upcoming November election, aiming to represent a district that encompasses parts of Weld and Boulder counties.
* This selection process has sparked debate, as nearly a third of state lawmakers last session were appointed by similar committees rather than elected directly by voters, highlighting concerns about the democratic integrity of such appointments.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

body:
I speak out strongly for all female athletes like me who’ve been forced to compete against men.
| Peter, I’m Riley Gaines. You may have heard my name in the news. I’m an All-American swimmer -- but I’m better known for my role in the fight to save women’s sports.
Women and girls have a right to compete fairly, and to private locker rooms. I speak out strongly for all female athletes like me who’ve been forced to compete against men. **Just this year, a female golfer lost her spot in the U.S. Women’s Open qualifier at Bradenton to a man, James “Hailey” Davidson.** Then, USA Today _took down_ a brilliant op-ed by Republican Senator John Kennedy. In the op-ed, he demanded to know if “inclusion” should be prioritized over fairness and safety when it comes to sports. But Peter, I won’t be censored! Instead, I seek to build a community of thousands of sensible Americans who know the difference between a man and a woman. I started the Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute so that women would have a place to speak out against the gender ideology radicals. Please, join me and stand for women, free speech, and common sense.
[With a gift of $100 or more, I’ll send you a copy of my new book, _Swimming Against the Current: Fighting for Common Sense in a World That’s Lost its Mind._](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=a6d1e49d09264325b86eca1acf71dd50&_e=aJsXkvvGhSEl4Rh9q3k75qXM49vG2MpBCNRFSRbkXaShHbhUxVLvoW2eBfuUMzTCcNQ9T8UuZPzPKINUT2ofbFgldIcq9yTO7r2VBsyrL4-mM74mRy27bpWehnO_0miRgRm6a83-4V1-k0yvuumPts84RHaDJIwj6BHwkn3qxKrflo2rIPOHyBRgnPp6pBPfhlijzXoJNJBzMTi8QZAAcqybmL55wVtl8MphnWlkGDClxrfVW0gUih3A2pJxzciJcYvxJufmXhpsNjSV9pIr5_U1g4LKwXbsRc2BPmDco40KSTisWTvZuOWRVSBx4u7EKDEN8Ay8irctGLyCoC_g0GvpO0ktz_GzvbajyeSUfMCHUxRgxtNv7pfQ_KlK-57TVNKvV3yEDKvxYbbtt8khcWGl9-9YHeVy6KrQV9blvdqx3CADsXL2F-gWtBFrJPOT5ZekNpgCMUrcOHXPg29tg3WYeMdQ7q2BCL8fMqF8cTybRU8leTR60CPF8euunz0QSZwCkgS5yqsfE7m_YNglog%3D%3D) I look forward to hearing from you, Peter, Stand bravely with me, Riley Gaines Director of the Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute P.S. body:
Dr Phil: “To breed or not to breed, that’s the question we are asking tonight.”
| | |
---
| [](https://bcu8ldbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nzJNvijfrgkE-pgqMt0vxjCm98l0QSuQJl44yt-rNoily2k-nnho5rV-CFgmEvu9FZD-q9jVieC3_c_DIiEtoplnv_kK_P36d4IpvZTLIzmoGUQIOk0zPBwmsTyqZ1OPOM8EJYcASiAVukvhETWRjWOrD4-oEevNCccSFrWr9aO7AUB8ajDziauACcb3VnCCWxqavea4S9pKLvk-IOYN6X7pKX66yEIoMsOb_uiEY8U=&c=kHiFAkBXJYvLAasnuBm242Gr7UJlJGJGI9YPlDcMzGkFr8pezzbA-A==&ch=2GzN7hk41ThKcH5O0l-fPUUdikVBzY9bPicPYOOGW5pIS_ioKzTWYQ==)

| Friends,
I wanted to share some exciting news with you--I recently [appeared on Dr. Phil](https://bcu8ldbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nzJNvijfrgkE-pgqMt0vxjCm98l0QSuQJl44yt-rNoily2k-nnho5tFM-4EZWG0lJk5ALSeps5IHxq4IUHqal5gHga2QeUnQGMS_FvW0mdNcm14f0m6_EEBevaSrQrPFrlbY-W-L2WALu-Rv8Zmi72B5_PTnLdvCX5ApcxPB4NUAcN7hA1QG6O4D69LkQG8kcnlWFazULW1Jd9PxUC6IkRCd-cpdqiKHn4DMPevf7WavJVQNGg8eTA==&c=kHiFAkBXJYvLAasnuBm242Gr7UJlJGJGI9YPlDcMzGkFr8pezzbA-A==&ch=2GzN7hk41ThKcH5O0l-fPUUdikVBzY9bPicPYOOGW5pIS_ioKzTWYQ==) to defend the importance of families! The episode aired just last night, and it was a truly remarkable experience.
---
| [](https://bcu8ldbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nzJNvijfrgkE-pgqMt0vxjCm98l0QSuQJl44yt-rNoily2k-nnho5tFM-4EZWG0lJk5ALSeps5IHxq4IUHqal5gHga2QeUnQGMS_FvW0mdNcm14f0m6_EEBevaSrQrPFrlbY-W-L2WALu-Rv8Zmi72B5_PTnLdvCX5ApcxPB4NUAcN7hA1QG6O4D69LkQG8kcnlWFazULW1Jd9PxUC6IkRCd-cpdqiKHn4DMPevf7WavJVQNGg8eTA==&c=kHiFAkBXJYvLAasnuBm242Gr7UJlJGJGI9YPlDcMzGkFr8pezzbA-A==&ch=2GzN7hk41ThKcH5O0l-fPUUdikVBzY9bPicPYOOGW5pIS_ioKzTWYQ==)
---
|
The topic of the episode was: "To breed or not to breed, that's the question we are asking tonight." \- Dr. Phil
I had the opportunity to share some of my thoughts on the show. Here's a quick highlight [from my segment:](https://bcu8ldbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nzJNvijfrgkE-pgqMt0vxjCm98l0QSuQJl44yt-rNoily2k-nnho5tFM-4EZWG0lJk5ALSeps5IHxq4IUHqal5gHga2QeUnQGMS_FvW0mdNcm14f0m6_EEBevaSrQrPFrlbY-W-L2WALu-Rv8Zmi72B5_PTnLdvCX5ApcxPB4NUAcN7hA1QG6O4D69LkQG8kcnlWFazULW1Jd9PxUC6IkRCd-cpdqiKHn4DMPevf7WavJVQNGg8eTA==&c=kHiFAkBXJYvLAasnuBm242Gr7UJlJGJGI9YPlDcMzGkFr8pezzbA-A==&ch=2GzN7hk41ThKcH5O0l-fPUUdikVBzY9bPicPYOOGW5pIS_ioKzTWYQ==)
"The rewards that you get from having children, having a family--you know, we just had number seven, and when you see the other six children hold that baby, kiss that baby, take care of that baby, and participate in their family and give of themselves in sacrifice, it's one of the most beautiful and rewarding things you can experience." \- Me!
I would love to hear your feedback and responses on why we should encourage everyone to have children. Your perspective means a lot to me, and I believe that by sharing our experiences and thoughts, we can truly make a positive impact.
Looking forward to hearing from you!
---

clean_body: Here’s everything you need to know about the Left’s 2024 plan to retake the seats they lost in 2022: | Fellow Conservative, Just last week, State and National Democrats announced a coordinated campaign to spend $5 MILLION in targeted New York races, with ours at the top of their list. This is after it was revealed that my Democrat opponent more than doubled our fundraising last quarter. Fellow Conservative, I’ll be blunt. I don’t know how sustainable our lead in the polls will be if these fundraising numbers continue. The entire House Majority could hinge on the seat and the Democrats are playing for keeps in this race. I need to catch up right now, or my lead will evaporate overnight. Thank you and God bless, Marc Molinaro Congressman, NY-19 | | Paid for by Marc for US

# [Demand a criminal investigation into $10 million bribe to Trump by Egyptian president](https://default.salsalabs.org/T464b36a7-a233-4a12-a111-5a1a647a2455/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | Did the Egyptian president give Trump a $10 million bribe in 2016 to keep the Trump campaign from going broke? There's a heck of a lot of evidence that seems to indicate that, according to a new Washington Post [investigation](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb45e6330-90f3-4863-8937-ba0404d99d45/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) (as seen on [Rachel Maddow's show](https://default.salsalabs.org/T668b6871-32f4-46f7-b7be-520dc4a3ab35/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)). In fact, the Justice Department actually opened up an investigation at that time. **But Attorney General Bill Barr -- a Trump appointee -- ordered it shut down.** [**Add your name, and demand the Justice Department re-open the investigation.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tfdf413b8-994d-4f0c-bd73-6a0a8f41e537/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) We can't have a functioning government if the head of that government is taking bribes from other countries in exchange for doing their bidding. There is strong evidence that Trump did just that, and America and the world needs to know what happened. [**Add your name, and demand the Justice Department re-open the investigation into the $10 million bribe.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T977fda05-eacb-4f9e-a10b-063203e9860a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

body:
https://www.perelesformissouri.com/ [https://www.perelesformissouri.com/]
Peter,
Results from Tuesday's primary election contest in Missouri are in, and the field is now set in my race: it will be me versus far-right extremist David Gregory.
Gregory is best known for filing frivolous lawsuits that have achieved nothing but wasting taxpayers money in an effort to advance his political career. He is a Trump-first MAGA extremist who cares more about his own political ambition than about making life better for anyone.
David Gregory is a fervent supporter of Missouri’s total abortion ban—a law that makes no exceptions for cases of rape or incest, and which has caused chaos and wreaked havoc for women and families. Notably, Gregory is endorsed by Missouri Right to Life, an anti-choice group that opposes all abortion and most forms of contraception, IVF, emergency Plan B contraception, embryonic stem cell research, and even the Equal Rights Amendment.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perelesformissouri24?refcode=primaryresults_screenshot [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perelesformissouri24?refcode=primaryresults_screenshot]
Missouri cannot afford any more MAGA extremists like Gregory making decisions about our rights, our healthcare, and our future.
Symbolic, unworkable policies designed solely to appeal to the MAGA base don’t solve problems. Endless cable news culture wars don’t solve problems. Scorched earth negative attacks on anyone who disagrees with you do not solve problems . This is all that David Gregory has to offer.
We need adults in the room who can sit down with Republicans and Democrats alike, who will take time to meet with constituents and listen to their concerns, and who won’t first ask “ is this something that would make Donald Trump happy? ” before making important decisions that affect us all.
Now that the field is finally set, can you make a contribution of $25, $50, or more to help power us to a crucial victory over MAGA extremism? With so much on the line, we need to work harder than ever to win hearts and minds this November so that we can get things done for the people of Missouri: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perelesformissouri24?refcode=primaryresults&amount=50]

Tracey Mann

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1738%2E135344%2EGpVEmF)

Friend -
First and foremost, I want to thank you for your support in advance of yesterday's U.S. Senate primary in Michigan. It is an honor to be the Democratic nominee for Senate. I will work as hard as I ever have for anything in order to win this November.
Now the sprint is on to the general election, where we'll face Republican Mike Rogers.
This is going to be one of the most expensive and competitive races in the country, the polls show it starts off extremely close, and I won't be able to win this alone. So, today, I am asking for your support to get us off on the right foot:
[**Are you able to make a contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate in Michigan? We're looking for lots of donations on this first day of the general election. Use this link to give.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240807-1-900&t=2&akid=1738%2E135344%2EGpVEmF)
**[CONTRIBUTE NOW](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240807-1-900&t=3&akid=1738%2E135344%2EGpVEmF)**
So, who is Mike Rogers, the Republican who won the GOP nomination?
First, he was Trump's endorsed candidate in the Republican primary.
He was on the Trump national security transition team before 2017, and was in talks to be Trump’s Director of FBI, but then got removed from Trump’s team. Then he became a critic of Trump, even going so far as to call him “more gangster than presidential,” became a commentator for CNN, and even considered a run for President against him.
Then, in a truly stunning about-face, he changed his tune in order to gain Trump's favor in this Senate race. And it worked. He’s been kissing the Trump ring ever since.
But there's much more beyond Trump:
He has supported an extreme nationwide abortion ban with no exceptions for rape, incest, or common miscarriage; he authored 4 bills that would ban IVF; he voted to cut and privatize Social Security and Medicare. He represented a version of my current congressional district, 4 years before I flipped it – but with a different set of values.
Not only does this one race have the possibility of determining control of the Senate, but it is a microcosm of which direction the Senate will take as a whole depending on who wins.
Like I said, this race will be incredibly expensive and competitive. All the polls are tight, and how we start this general election may determine how it ends. So I am asking:
[**Can you please contribute $3 directly to my campaign for U.S. Senate in Michigan? We're looking for a large number of donations on the first day of this general election.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240807-1-900&t=4&akid=1738%2E135344%2EGpVEmF)

| Peter, It’s time for some real talk. We’re going to call this our regular _Nonsense Call-Out._ There’s no immediate action to be taken, but boy does someone need to be put on blast for this. Per usual, the viewpoint of some high-handed elites is getting more coverage than the thinking of New Jersey's (and America’s) common sense majority. So here it is.
---
|
---
|
## Nonsense Call-Out of the Week:
Common sense Americans have been getting called “weird” a lot lately – by the ones who are actually “weird.”
---
|
---
| If you’ve been avoiding the news, here’s some of the headlines lately from all our favorite elite and out-of-touch outlets, who may as well be the unpaid PR department of the Left. Journalism is dead, friends, and it has been for a while.

---
|
---
| “Weird” is the new favorite attack tactic by Left Wing Lunatics who are on the losing side of the issues Americans will care most about in November – like chaos at the southern border, out-of-control costs, a flailing economy, and woke madness in our schools. Like a bully with a big mouth (and in this case, with the media as their willing megaphone), the Left has decided to simply point and scream “weird!” at...oddly enough...those of us with common sense. In the logic of the Left, J.D. Vance making a quip to highlight the important perspective of parents in setting our country’s future direction is _weird_ – along with wanting to secure our border, avoid socialism, have fair elections, and protect our kids. **What does the Left consider normal?**
* A biological male beating up a female boxer in the Olympics and stealing her medal opportunity after years of training.
* Drag queens posing in a mockery of the last supper.
* Pornographic materials in schools and kindergartners watching drag shows and pride parades.
* College students shutting down classes and campuses to join Hamas-sympathizing “protests.”
* Riots that destroy businesses and cities.
* Major theft decriminalized so people can steal from retailers with impunity.

Now that’s _weird_ – It’s B.S. Dangerous. Vile. Criminal. Disgusting – and we could use some much stronger words to describe it. **We refuse to allow this type of madness to be called normal while American values are denigrated as _weird._** **Enough is enough.** The emperor has no clothes. We’re saying it. The thing is, most Americans and New Jerseyans are seeing through this crap. Most of us are reasonable people who want to raise our families, live our lives as we choose, enjoy a semblance of safety, work hard to create a comfortable life, practice our faith, and be proud of our country. We’re simply asking that the government stop over taxing us, regulating us to death, jabbing us with vaccines, interfering in our decisions, and trying to raise our kids. Is that too much to ask? _Frankly, it’s not._ Does this resonate with you? Congratulations! You are a common sense American!

name: Nigel4NC
subject: Campaign Update - Nigel Bristow for NC9
body:
Dear Supporters,

We have some fantastic news to share with you!

We’re thrilled to announce the opening of our first campaign office in
Guilford County, located at 2302 W Meadowview Rd Suite #235 Greensboro, NC
27407. This is a significant milestone in our journey, and we couldn't have
reached this point without your unwavering support. Our new office will
serve as a hub for organizing, outreach, and rallying the community around
our shared vision for North Carolina’s 9th Congressional District. If
you’re in the area, we’d love for you to drop by, meet the team, and learn
how you can get involved!

In other exciting news, we’re absolutely delighted to see Tim Walz join the
Democratic ticket. His commitment to protecting women’s reproductive
rights, common sense gun control, and dedication to serving the American
people align perfectly with the values we hold dear. Tim’s experience and
leadership are a tremendous asset to our cause, and we’re eager to work
alongside him to drive change and build a brighter future for all.

As we move forward, we need your help more than ever. We’re looking for
dedicated volunteers to help spread the word about our campaign. Whether
it's phonebanking, knocking on doors, or talking to friends and neighbors,
your efforts will make a huge difference. If you’re interested in
volunteering, please reach out to us at Nigel4NC@gmail.com and put
“volunteer” as the subject line and someone will reach out to you to get
you involved!

Additionally, running a campaign requires significant resources, and we
greatly appreciate any financial support you can provide. Your
contributions will help us reach more voters, organize impactful events,
and get our message out across the district. To make a contribution, please
visit https://secure.actblue.com/donate/Nigel-Bristow-for-congress-1. If
you would prefer to send a check, please make checks payable to “Nigel
Bristow for Congress” and mail them to PO Box 2394 Rockingham, NC 28380.

Your support has been instrumental in getting us this far, and as we move
forward, we’re more energized and determined than ever. Together, we can
make a real difference and bring the change we need for our community.

Thank you for standing with us every step of the way. Stay tuned for more
updates and ways to get involved as we continue this exciting journey!

Warm regards,

*Nigel Bristow*
Candidate for Congress, NC-9

Thank you.
While the results of this primary election didn’t turn out as we had hoped, I want to express my deepest gratitude to everyone who supported our campaign. Thank you for your trust, your hard work, and your belief in our vision for the future.
Though we didn’t win this time, our fight for the issues that matter most — affordable healthcare, strong schools, good jobs, and a clean environment — continues.
We’ve raised important conversations about providing affordable housing, supporting working families, investing in our infrastructure, and honoring our veterans.
These are the priorities that will shape the future of Northern Michigan, and I remain committed to these causes.
Now, more than ever, it’s important that we come together and unite as a community. We must continue working toward the goal of a stronger, more inclusive Northern Michigan and Upper Peninsula.
Let’s keep pushing forward, supporting the progress we’ve made, and standing up for what we believe in. Together, we can still make a difference.
Yours eternally,

name: Matt Diemer
subject: This is not democracy
body:
| |
---
Peter, When I first ran for Congress in 2022, I faced an opponent who had the backing of big money and corporate interests. Even though he outraised us, we beat the odds and performed exceptionally well, thanks to the grassroots support of people like you who believe in a more just future for Ohio and our country. One of the biggest challenges we face in this race — and our democracy as a whole — is the corrupting influence of money in politics. The current system is broken. It allows special interests and wealthy donors to wield outsized influence, drowning out the voices of everyday Americans. This is not what our democracy was meant to be. It’s a system that benefits those at the top while leaving hardworking families and individuals behind. I’m committed to fighting for campaign finance reform that levels the playing field, regardless of financial backing. But here’s the reality: until we can change the system, we have to work within it. That means I urgently need your help to build a campaign that can compete against the deep pockets of my opponent. I know it’s frustrating to hear, but this is what we’re stuck with for now. And while I hate to ask for money, your support is crucial in this fight. [If you can, please chip in so we can elect a politician who truly cares about the people, not just the profits.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqueYr7edJk8d-KbippARHFY4BiME9vwGwgX6_vE2JnoR1-vYw-5cE8RmkbzAaPMrWH8gqnkXgW_0dK2pODuig2x9u_VLMfKWwLmONeLCZKd5qyNZ9_C5JpzbT7__t-KEafY-7-J-OM1x_8jTQatLzxc4wlbOAQAALKvK5uuN4b_rW86e_XKTlpz24M2spOog6YqTt6CdJ7FIVsP2w9oyAzle51QvGjNWBygJ9CNOGkjM63isTeYuI3UCLF4ces-TXk_8q1XTliZePCyxA10TXnt6AZdkheRG5sMDhfKsprNoJ7W44Cq1kTIvCxxvY_EjdM/48p/0G4In6twRNiA2vDH_bsVCA/h0/h001.66YLPEf-2jiCOnXMWrCs6WI9yw4rVyQF1PpO8U4zd0A)

subject: 👋 Hi, my name is Bethany Mann
body:
I am proud to be your Democratic Nominee for Congress | |
---
Hi Friend,
---
It’s Bethany Mann, Democratic candidate for US Congress! Our campaign is on the move and lots of exciting things are happening, but before I get into all that, I wanted to take a moment to introduce myself.
---
|
---
I grew up in Foristell. I was homeschooled. I am a proud St. Charles County resident. I live in St. Peters with my husband Carson (a local musician) and our three kids (including two rambunctious toddlers!). I started my career as an intern at the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) testing water and soil samples for environmental contaminants dumped into our nation’s land by big corporate polluters. Now I am qualified to run for Congress because of my experience in manufacturing, agriculture, water, and energy infrastructure. I am happy to be a pro-climate science nerd. For years I have labored to protect our environment for my children, and I am sick and tired of politicians ignoring our community and failing to protect the future for my kids. I decided enough was enough—which is why I decided to launch my campaign for Congress. If our current legislators weren’t going to build a better future for my kids, it’s time to replace them.
---
|
---
I believe in equal and fair bargaining rights for farmers, advancing developments in our infrastructure from broadband technology to roads and bridges, and ensuring that our students receive equal access to high-quality education and fully-funded schools. I know Congressional District 3 isn’t a slam-dunk for a Democratic candidate, but I decided to run anyway—because our children and our community deserve better. I am excited to share that I have hired a team and we are organizing in communities across our district. We are investing in campaign infrastructure and working to talk to voters who haven’t heard from a Democrat in years, if not a decade. I am passionate about education, science, and bringing people together. My goal is to make the 3rd District and Missouri a state leader when it comes to important issues that build the middle class and strengthen Missouri families. And I need your help to do it. **Friend, we are talking to voters in every county and every city in our district, but we need your help to talk to folks in your community. Can you help us by canvassing or joining our virtual phone-banks?**

| Dear Fellow American,

If you haven't already ordered my latest book **_Rights and Freedoms in Peril_** : **_An Investigative Report on The Left 's Attack on America,_** I urge you to [ORDER IT NOW!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69510&L=32838&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9qdWRpY2lhbHdhdGNoYm9vay5jb20vP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX3Rlcm09TWF5&hash=41712b6ac06d77a0a61ccbb0269a1daea2441121c84d24f8dbb7176da4087ce2)
My publisher needs to know how many to print, and I need to tell him in the next few days!
My previous books hit the **_New York Times_** and other bestseller lists and **_Rights and Freedoms in Peril_** is sure to follow suit...but to be sure we have enough so you can get your copy, please [**_ACT NOW_** _and order today_](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69510&L=32838&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9qdWRpY2lhbHdhdGNoYm9vay5jb20vP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX3Rlcm09TWF5&hash=41712b6ac06d77a0a61ccbb0269a1daea2441121c84d24f8dbb7176da4087ce2).
Here's what my friend **Sean Hannity** said about it: **_" When it comes to fighting for the American people's 'right to know,' no one holds a candle to Tom Fitton and his team at Judicial Watch" _**
[](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69510&L=32838&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9qdWRpY2lhbHdhdGNoYm9vay5jb20vP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX3Rlcm09TWF5&hash=41712b6ac06d77a0a61ccbb0269a1daea2441121c84d24f8dbb7176da4087ce2)
**_I call upon you and all patriotic Americans to help me battle for the soul and survival of America_****... _what I have to say in my book is that important_**!
| [ORDER NOW](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69510&L=32838&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9qdWRpY2lhbHdhdGNoYm9vay5jb20vP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX3Rlcm09TWF5&hash=41712b6ac06d77a0a61ccbb0269a1daea2441121c84d24f8dbb7176da4087ce2)
---

In **_Rights and Freedoms in Peril_** I rip open the wall of secrecy surrounding Washington to expose the radical Left's efforts to dismantle our venerable institutions...

I take you to the front lines where the radical Left threatens America by undermining the core principles that make this country a beacon of hope to the world.

Marxist-inspired radicals have declared war on everything from the rule of law to our colorblind merit-based society, border security, economic stability and government accountability. **Their anti-American agenda must be stopped ...**

[ORDER NOW](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69510&L=32838&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9qdWRpY2lhbHdhdGNoYm9vay5jb20vP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX3Rlcm09TWF5&hash=41712b6ac06d77a0a61ccbb0269a1daea2441121c84d24f8dbb7176da4087ce2)
---

In **_Rights and Freedoms in Peril_** I sound the alarm about:
* Who's behind our open border?

* Who's leading the legal warfare against Donald Trump?

* Who's behind Joe Biden and Kamala Harris?

Here's who: The Leftist Deep State is joined by Marxists of every stripe in attempting to rewrite the social contract that holds our society together - the contract between the government and its citizens - the United States Constitution and the rule of law.

**We cannot do enough to protect our nation from our radical Leftist enemies!**

That's why I encourage you to **[ORDER YOUR COPY TODAY](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=69510&L=32838&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9qdWRpY2lhbHdhdGNoYm9vay5jb20vP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX3Rlcm09TWF5&hash=41712b6ac06d77a0a61ccbb0269a1daea2441121c84d24f8dbb7176da4087ce2)** while there's still time!

Tom Fitton

body:
We made plans based on the fundraising levels we were at last week — media plans, outreach, organizing, you name it. Things we need to do to win this race, critical strategic programs. But since then, we’ve raised less and less every single day.
#

Peter, we just came off some of the strongest fundraising days of our entire campaign.
After our primary election, after our July end-of-month fundraising deadline, things were going great.
We made plans based on the fundraising levels we were at last week — media plans, outreach, organizing, you name it. Things we need to do to win this race, critical strategic programs. But since then, we’ve raised less and less every single day.
Just look at this chart of the last seven days of our fundraising:

That big, tall bar on the left is July 31st, our deadline. That little tiny bar on the right is yesterday. We’ve fallen off a cliff, and things are not looking good. If we don’t turn it around it could be a disaster for Ruben’s campaign and our chances at holding control in the U.S. Senate.
Now, we’re not writing this to scare you. And the good news is we have plenty of time to turn this around. But we’re hoping that by being honest, by showing you exactly how far we’ve fallen over the last seven days, you’ll understand how important your support is.
We’re hoping that you’ll help Ruben out, because we really need you right now.

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: I am officially the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Michigan
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gillibrand for Senate
body:
Friend—
It’s official. I am the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate here in Michigan.

I’m so grateful to Michigan voters for entrusting me not only with this honor, but also the responsibility of keeping Michigan and this U.S. Senate seat blue in November. I will not let you down.

Because there is just too much at stake:

Whether Michigan is a place where anyone can get in and stay in the middle class.

Whether our granddaughters have fewer rights than their grandmothers.

Whether the American experiment of a multi-racial, multi-ethnic democracy continues.

And whether Michigan contributes to keeping the White House, and making history.

So you can bet I will be working harder than I ever have before. I know that we can win this, but it will take all of us. My team has set a rather ambitious $100,000 General Election Founding Donor Goal for the next week so that we can hit the ground running in the sprint to the general election. Will you split a donation of $5 between Kirsten Gillibrand and my campaign tonight and become a General Election Founding Donor?

In short: the real race begins now, friend. We’re up against Donald Trump and Mitch McConnell’s handpicked candidate, Mike Rogers, a man who has shown that he’ll say or do anything to get elected.

He has co-sponsored bills that would not only ban abortion nationwide, but threaten in-vitro fertilization and birth control. He supported privatizing Social Security and Medicare. After 20 years as a politician, Rogers left Michigan for good. He cashed in on his D.C. connections to make millions by helping Chinese tech companies, giving them access to the United States. And in doing so, increased his net worth by as much as 2,000%. Then he bought a mansion in Florida and two yachts. He is only moving back to Michigan to run for the Senate.

It’s clear: Mike Rogers is only looking out for himself.

I will be working to make sure every Michigan voter understands just how bad Mike Rogers would be for Michiganders if elected to the Senate, but we need resources to start immediately holding him accountable to his record.

Will you become a General Election Founding Donor today and chip in $5 to Kirsten Gillibrand and my campaign?

Thank you for your support.
Elissa

A note from Kirsten:
Friend, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. As Democrats face our toughest Senate map in decades, I need your help more than ever.

While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 — and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority.

As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. But I refuse to take a single cent from corporate PACs, which means I’m relying on your grassroots support. So please, chip in to help defend our narrow Democratic Senate majority. And if you’d like to become a core member of my team and receive exclusive texts from my campaign, text JOIN to 60708.

Thank you,
Kirsten Gillibrand
