name: Chrissy Houlahan
subject: Quick update from Congress
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chrissy Houlahan for Congress
body:
A NOTE FROM CHRISSY There’s been so much political news lately that it’s easy to forget that we’re also really busy helping our community and advancing policy solutions to some of our country’s big problems. This is why I do this important work so I want to share a few of those things. I hosted U.S. Secretary of Agriculture Tom Vilsack in our district, voted against a bill to require everyone to have a U.S. Passport in order to vote, pushed for the IRS to re-open its service center in Reading, and called on the U.S. Department of Education to respond to the student-led social media attack against teachers at Great Valley Middle School. I am also:

https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/houlahan-digital?refcode=jtk1025-ot-text&amounts=5,25,50,100,250

Investigating the Attempted Assassination I was honored to be appointed by Speaker Johnson to join the bipartisan task force that will investigate the attempted assassination of former President Donald Trump. Legislation to establish this task force passed Congress 416-0 which gives me hope that we can do this without the political bias and the rhetoric that has so divided our nation. This horrible act of violence goes against the very fabric of our country and must be condemned from every side of the political spectrum – and prevented from happening again.

https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/houlahan-digital?refcode=jtk1025-ot-text&amounts=5,25,50,100,250

Preventing Another Baby Formula Shortage If you remember the baby formula shortage in 2022, you'll know that many parents faced the difficult challenge of not knowing how their child would get the nutrients they needed to grow. With my new bipartisan bill, the Investing in New Families and Newborns Through Tax Credit Act, I hope not only to give a necessary boost to the baby formula industry – including ByHeart in Berks County – but also to build on our district's long history of manufacturing.

https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/houlahan-digital?refcode=jtk1025-ot-text&amounts=5,25,50,100,250

Celebrating Pride in Berks County The celebration of Pride continued as Berks County saw its 18th annual Pride Fest! It comforts me to know that our district is a place where our LGBT+ neighbors can safely gather as their authentic selves to celebrate the LGBT+ community. As always, I'll continue to fight back against the growing wave of GOP hate so that PA-06 remains a district where our neighbors of all identities can feel at home. That's all, folks! These next few months are going to be jam-packed and I look forward to keeping you updated. There's work to be done, Chrissy

| | | Did the Egyptian president give Trump a $10 million bribe in 2016 to keep the Trump campaign from going broke? There's a heck of a lot of evidence that seems to indicate that, according to a new Washington Post [investigation](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6e313ef0-a92a-4a1f-8b1a-3351c224df43/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) (as seen on [Rachel Maddow's show](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4634fc4b-6aff-4349-9513-7684b00c5fa8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)). In fact, the Justice Department actually opened up an investigation at that time. **But Attorney General Bill Barr -- a Trump appointee -- ordered it shut down.** [**Add your name, and demand the Justice Department re-open the investigation.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf5e6fedb-4c8f-4a24-b4f5-1af023f74f71/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) We can't have a functioning government if the head of that government is taking bribes from other countries in exchange for doing their bidding. There is strong evidence that Trump did just that, and America and the world needs to know what happened. [**Add your name, and demand the Justice Department re-open the investigation into the $10 million bribe.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta2f2db96-9016-48d3-b121-871e694b808a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

body:
Though the Biden administration has publicly denied it, one of the
Jordanian illegal immigrants released from federal custody after being
charged for trying to breach a U.S. military base appears on a terror
watch list, according to records obtained by Judicial Watch.

Though the Biden administration has publicly denied it, one of the
Jordanian illegal immigrants released from federal custody after being
charged for trying to breach a U.S. military base appears on a terror
watch list, according to records obtained by Judicial Watch. The men,
32-year-old Hasan Yousef Hamdan and 28-year-old Mohammad Khair Dabous,
posted bail in early June and were released by the Washington D.C.
Enforcement and Removal Operations (ERO) division of Immigration and
Customs Enforcement (ICE), the records show. A Department of Justice
(DOJ) immigration judge in Annandale, Virginia set Dabous’ bail at
$10,000 and Hamdan’s at $15,000 and they were freed after posting
bond and agreeing to stay away from military facilities and to appear
in court for immigration hearings.

Mike Haridopolos, a committed advocate for our values and a proven conservative leader, is running for Congress, and we need your help to ensure his success.
We are organizing several volunteer activities and would greatly appreciate your participation. Here’s how you can get involved:

* **When:** Friday, August 9th from 4-6 pm
* **Location 1:** The corner of Palm Bay Rd and Babcock in Palm Bay

* **Details:** Join fellow supporters in waving signs and spreading awareness about Mike’s campaign. It’s a fun and energizing way to show your support and connect with the community. Wear comfy shoes, hats, sunglasses, and sunscreen. Signs will be provided.

[SIGN UP HERE](https://link.support.mike4congress.)

**Polling Place Sign Wave on August 20th:**
* **When:** Election Day, Tuesday August 20th (various hours)
* **Where:** Polling locations throughout the county
* **Details:** Hold a sign and wave to voters as they come in. Your presence can make a significant difference in ensuring as many voters choose Mike as possible.

We understand how valuable your time is, and any amount of help you can provide is greatly appreciated. Volunteering is not only a wonderful way to support Mike, but it’s also an opportunity to meet like-minded individuals and make new friends.
Thank you for your continued support and dedication. Together, we can have an excellent primary.
Warm regards,
Team Haridopolos

---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90380765/490321615/1793776944?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20240807_f_vra_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTdkMzljZi1jZjU0LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AjbCKyzDOcm3XyqvQgq9q5RBasV51nR_hvp6sk3iDcI=&emci=0df13b89-c654-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=617d39cf-cf54-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=1037277)

| | Friends, Yesterday marked the 59th anniversary of the signing of the Voting Rights Acts (VRA) of 1965. For years, Jim Crow-era laws stripped away rights and freedoms from Black Americans. Voter suppression tactics like poll taxes, literacy tests, requirements to own property, and violence kept Black Americans from going to the polls and using their voices to demand equality and representation. Signed at the height of the civil rights movement, the VRA prohibited racial discrimination in voting. Its passage strengthened our nation’s democracy, and led to a significant increase in Black voter registration and political representation, including 250,000 new registrations by the end of 1965. name: Monroe County Republican Committee
subject: Monroe County GOP Volunteer Opportunities
body:
90 DAYS OUT! This is when we need you the most. Please read the
information below on volunteer opportunities and call with any questions.
It's easier for me to speak with you directly. If you have 1 hour a week
to help get Republicans elected, that will help put us over the finish line
on these crucial races!!!

We have candidates attending events throughout Monroe County. The easiest
way to do this is to let me know what days you are available. Let's say
you can do Saturday from 1:00pm-3:00pm. I'll plug you into an event.

We are currently walking in towns doing literature drops. This can be done
at any time. IT IS NOT KNOCKING ON DOORS! Just literature drops.

Calls--we are calling Registered Republicans that are 70+ years old asking
if they would like an absentee ballot or a ride to the polls. (You can
also visit in person) These are fun calls!

We are looking for as many people as possible to sign up to walk with the
Monroe County Republican Committee in the Labor Day Parade on Monday Sept.
2nd. Please see the link below to sign up. We would really like a large
showing!!! Bring your family and friends!

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScmHKJosa-ak8eWk8_VgvXUu71deCSW83D8Vs7Urd1XsxgSTA/viewform?usp=sf_link

WE REALLY NEED YOUR HELP! WE REALLY NEED YOUR HELP! Did I say WE REALLY
NEED YOUR HELP? Cause we do! Looking forward to hearing from you all!

Yvonne Donnelly
Chief of Staff
MCRC
546-8040

So, who is Mike Rogers, the Republican who won the GOP nomination?
First, he was Trump's endorsed candidate in the Republican primary.
He was on the Trump national security transition team before 2017 and was in talks to be Trump’s director of FBI, but then got removed from Trump’s team. Then he became a critic of Trump, even going so far as to call him “more gangster than presidential,” became a commentator for _CNN_ , and even considered a run for president against him.
Then, in a truly stunning about-face, he changed his tune in order to gain Trump's favor in this Senate race. And it worked. He’s been kissing the Trump ring ever since.
But there's much more beyond Trump:
He has supported an extreme nationwide abortion ban with no exceptions for rape, incest, or common miscarriage; he authored four bills that would ban IVF; he voted to cut and privatize Social Security and Medicare. He represented a version of my current congressional district, four years before I flipped it – but with a different set of values.
Not only does this one race have the possibility of determining control of the Senate, but it is a microcosm of which direction the Senate will take as a whole depending on who wins.

body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90382621/490326473/1433120897?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZGFhNjBjOC1kMzU0LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9iz6DLGR4XRxd0l-KFBany0LSag7mPwo2ubCnBWWcUA=) It’s official: **I am honored to be your Democratic nominee for Congress in Michigan’s 8th District!** When I entered the race eight months ago, I promised a campaign to unite our communities around a shared, hopeful vision for the future of our region and our country. Where hard work yields opportunity, and where all are welcome. Since then, we got to work. We knocked 14,000 doors. We made 22,000 phone calls. We sent 250,000 text messages — all culminating in tens of thousands of votes and a resounding victory in Michigan’s primary election. We brought together a coalition of union workers and retirees, small business owners, farmers, law enforcement, clergy members, local elected officials, parents, students and everyone who makes mid-Michigan so special. Last night, we took a massive step forward by winning the Primary – and we’re just getting started. Experts call this race a pure “toss-up” – one of the closest, most hotly contested House races in the entire country. It will determine which party controls the House. The stakes in this election are sky high, so I need you with me. I’m running against Paul Junge, a rich guy turned MAGA extremist trying to buy our votes. subject: This is another disappointing loss, but we’re not backing down.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

We have some deeply disappointing news,
Peter: the primary election results are in, and
incumbent Rep. Cori Bush has lost her seat in Missouri’s 1st Congressional
District.

These are not the results we had hoped to share with you after Justice
Democrats worked so hard alongside Cori’s team to go up against the
barrage of dark money attacks and lies from AIPAC, crypto groups, and
more.

Before I talk about the implications of this loss and what comes next, let
me first take a moment to celebrate Cori’s bravery in championing
Palestinian rights and other marginalized communities despite being
targeted by AIPAC. Her courage in sponsoring the ceasefire resolution and
calling out injustices both here and abroad is exactly what we need more
of in Congress.

We are forever grateful to Cori for taking her lived experience and
putting it into action for others, bravely sharing her own abortion story
as she fought for reproductive freedom, holding a sit-in on the Capitol
steps to demand an extension on the federal eviction moratorium, and
advocating for the progressive reform needed to bring justice to families
like Michael Brown’s and communities like Ferguson.

While these primary election results in MO-01 are crucial and undoubtedly
devastating, remember: we are winning the long-term fight against AIPAC.
Justice Democrats’ mission is to build a caucus of morally courageous
leaders. This race exemplifies our ongoing battle for a democracy that
serves the people, not special interests.

While Cori and Jamaal are major losses for our movement, their races show
that what we are doing is working. As we have said previously, AIPAC’s
massive spending in primaries like this one is coming from a position of
weakness. They have lost the battle of public opinion and have resorted to
forcible suppression of their opposition.

For many members of Congress, their money and threats work, and members
get in line. However, this is increasingly not the case, in large part due
to Justice Democrats’ elected leaders like the Squad, who refused to have
their voices suppressed even under the threat of losing their jobs.

This is a loss, but we are winning the long-term fight, and we won’t back
down.

With less than one week until our last primary election of the cycle in
Rep. Ilhan Omar’s Minnesota district, we cannot despair: we must come
together, refocus, and keep up the fight for the progressive leaders and
change we deserve.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240807-1.GpayUD&refcode=em20240807-35888&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=35888%2E1203867%2EmgWAcM ]Please, if you can, consider pitching in $5 to fuel our
efforts to help Ilhan defeat her opponent next Tuesday, August 13th. She
narrowly won by 2 percent last time around, so we can’t take anything for
granted.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240807-1.GpayUD&refcode=em20240807-35888&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1021&akid=35888%2E1203867%2EmgWAcM ]Contribute $5

Thank you again for all you’ve done to support Justice Democrats’ work to
build a bloc of young, diverse, working-class progressives in Congress and
transform the Democratic Party. Our fight continues.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

Friend,
I announced my campaign for the U.S. Senate 527 days ago. (Sweet lord!)
Today, I am officially the Democratic nominee.
But I didn’t do it alone. I would not be here without every person who was a part of this grassroots campaign. It was the work of tens of thousands of people who put out a yard sign, knocked doors, made phone calls, chipped in a few bucks, or cast their ballot for me in the primary.
Take a second to think about that: tens of thousands of people coming together for a better future, including you. That’s the energy we are all helping to produce across the country right now.
Thank you. I am proud of the movement we have built and I hope that you are too.
But for all that we have accomplished so far, our real work has just begun. The 90 day sprint is officially on.
So it is going to take each and every person who got us here -- and a few more! -- doing their part to keep Michigan blue in November.
I will be working harder than I ever have before over these next 3 months. But I cannot do it alone. I have relied on you to get to this point.
[**So I’m asking for your help again. Can I count on you to chip in $3 to help us get over the finish line and keep Michigan blue? body:
This will be one of the most competitive and expensive races in the country.

| Friends-

I was just officially declared the winner of the Democratic primary for U.S. Senate in Michigan.

And Trump-endorsed Mike Rogers was declared the winner of the Republican primary.

That means we have our general election match-up.

It's on. And the 90 day sprint to November has begun.

I'll have more to say about Mike Rogers and what happens next in the coming days. But for now, I am going to spend some time thanking supporters and volunteers who have gathered together in Detroit to celebrate our victory.

While that happens, I'll be keeping a close eye on our fundraising numbers tonight. With everything going on in politics, our opponent will get a boost, and we need one too. This is a big moment for the country, and both of our Senate campaigns. And the candidate whose supporters show up most will have a big advantage. So I am asking:

August 7, 2024
Recently, the Connecticut legislature passed early voting laws. The problem is that it is quite costly for the towns, especially the smaller ones, to staff all the polling places during the early voting period. Thus, early voting is only at one location at each town whereas voting on Election Day, August 13, will be at your usual polling place. More detailed information is below.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/433f1a29-e632-4b3c-add3-f2255099c38b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The day of the actual primary is August 13. Voting starts at 6:00 AM and ends at 8:00 PM. If you are unsure of your polling location, this link will direct you to where you vote. Please be aware that you must put in your exact name.
https://portaldir.ct.gov/sots/LookUp.aspx
When I placed Joe Bentivegna into this link, I was told that I did not exist (which would probably make many people happy). However, when I replaced "Joe" with "Joseph," I received the following response. Note that at the bottom is where I go to vote.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2fccff81-cb6a-4a46-a34e-ea54565c48cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Early voting started August 5 and ends August 11 (a Sunday). There is no early voting August 12 (Monday) and of course Election Day itself is August 13. The voting times are 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM but on August 8 (Thursday), the time is extended from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Here are the locations for early voting for each Fairfield County town:

Bridgeport Margaret Morton Government Center Conference Room C 999 Broad Street, Bridgeport, CT 06604
* Darien Town Hall Room 119 2 Renshaw Road, Darien, CT 06820
* Easton Easton Public Library Community Room 691 Morehouse Road, Easton CT 06612
* Fairfield Old Town Hall 2nd Floor 611 Old Post Road, Fairfield, CT 06824
* Greenwich Town Hall 101 Field Point Road, Greenwich, CT 06830
* Monroe Town Hall, Room 208 7 Fan Hill Road, Monroe, CT 06468
* New Canaan Town Hall Conference Room B (1st Floor) 77 Main St, New Canaan, CT 06840
* Norwalk City Hall 125 East Avenue, Norwalk, CT 06851
* Oxford Town Hall Meeting Room 486 Oxford Road, Oxford, CT 06478
* Redding Redding Community Center 37 Lonetown Road, Redding, CT 06896
* Ridgefield Town Hall 400 Main Street Ridgefield CT 06877
* Stamford Government Center Cafeteria 888 Washington Boulevard, Stamford, CT 06904
* Trumbull Town Hall Registrars' Office and adjacent corridor if needed 5866 Main Street, Trumbull, CT 06611
* Weston Town Hall Meeting Room 56 Norfield Road, Weston, CT 06883
* Westport Town Hall, Rm 201 110 Myrtle Avenue, Westport CT 06880
* Wilton Town Hall Room B 238 Danbury Road, Wilton, CT 06897

Regardless of how you plan to vote, please vote.

subject: Representing Rural Democrats
body:

# Representing Rural Democrats
---
|
---
We are fighting to make a real difference in rural America by representing rural Democrats. Rural communities care deeply about issues that align with Democratic values, though this often goes unnoticed in the media. No Dem Left Behind is committed to ensuring these communities have a strong voice on important issues and bringing their concerns to the national conversation. This country was built on hard work, dedication to one's craft, and a commitment to American values—principles that are still very much alive in rural America today. We cannot turn our backs on these communities now. That's why we are fighting in every battleground state to make a difference. We are working tirelessly in red states, such as Texas, to ensure that the voices of rural America are not drowned out. We believe in America, and we believe in the progress this country can achieve with rural America as a driving force. Together, we can make the change our nation needs.
---
|
---
Thank you for standing with us in this crucial fight. The world of politics can be overwhelming, especially given recent national and global events. In times like these, it's essential to remember that after the storm, clear skies await. With the right strategy and execution, progress for everyone and a stronger America are just around the corner. That's what makes this mission so important. If you can spare a little to support this work, we'd greatly appreciate it...

I am proud to call Governor Walz a friend.
#

Friends -
Yesterday, Vice President Kamala Harris named Minnesota Governor Tim Walz as her running mate.
I am proud to call Governor Walz a friend. We met back in 2007 when we were both in the same freshman class of the US House of Representatives. I saw his leadership in action back then, and have watched it grow in the years since.
Last year, I was proud to stand by Governor Walz’s side in Minnesota when he signed key gun violence prevention bills into law. The legislation closed dangerous loopholes in background checks and implemented extreme risk protection orders to temporarily prevent individuals who are at high risk of harming themselves or others from having access to firearms.

Folks, I know I spend a lot of time asking for your support, so today I want to talk for just a minute about what your donations really do .
If there’s one thing I’ve learned after running for office at the city, state, and federal levels, it’s that to win elections, you’ve got to really reach people where they are. That means having real conversations — person to person — with voters of all kinds (including folks who may not think of themselves as voters yet!).
My re-election campaign is working around the clock to do just that here in Virginia — opening offices, hiring field organizers on the ground, and recruiting volunteers in every corner of the Commonwealth to support the critical work of voter outreach between now and November.
Your donations make that possible—those $5, $10, and $25 contributions really do add up to make a serious difference. In July, more than 17,000 of you stepped up to donate online, and enthusiasm like that can be the difference between having enough folks on the ground to reach every undecided voter or missing out on important conversations.

So today, I’m asking you to pitch in $25 or more to help my campaign build up our field operation all across Virginia. Will you make a contribution? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]

subject: I am officially the Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate in Michigan
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alsobrooks for Senate
body:
[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/29652?t=1014&amount=25&akid=2173%2E52803%2EYwG_eZ ][IMG]

Peter—

It’s official. I am the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate here in
Michigan.

I’m so grateful to Michigan voters for entrusting me not only with this
honor, but also the responsibility of keeping Michigan and this U.S.
Senate seat blue in November. I will not let you down.

Because there is just too much at stake:

Whether Michigan is a place where anyone can get in and stay in the middle
class.

Whether our granddaughters have fewer rights than their grandmothers.

Whether the American experiment of a multi-racial, multi-ethnic democracy
continues.

And whether Michigan contributes to keeping the White House, and making
history.

So you can bet I will be working harder than I ever have before. I know
that we can win this, but it will take all of us. My team has set a rather
ambitious $100,000 General Election Founding Donor Goal for the next week
so that we can hit the ground running in the sprint to the general
election. [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/29652?t=1015&amount=25&akid=2173%2E52803%2EYwG_eZ ]Will you split a donation of $25 between Angela Alsobrooks
and my campaign tonight and become a General Election Founding Donor?

If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/29652?t=1020&express_lane=true&amount=250&akid=2173%2E52803%2EYwG_eZ ]Chip in $250 [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/29652?t=1021&amount=35&akid=2173%2E52803%2EYwG_eZ ]Other Amount

In short: the real race begins now,
Peter. We’re up against Donald
Trump and Mitch McConnell’s handpicked candidate, Mike Rogers, a man who
has shown that he’ll say or do anything to get elected.

He has co-sponsored bills that would not only ban abortion nationwide, but
threaten in-vitro fertilization and birth control. He supported
privatizing Social Security and Medicare. After 20 years as a politician,
Rogers left Michigan for good. He cashed in on his D.C. connections to
make millions by helping Chinese tech companies, giving them access to the
United States. And in doing so, increased his net worth by as much as
2,000%. Then he bought a mansion in Florida and two yachts. He is only
moving back to Michigan to run for the Senate.

It’s clear: Mike Rogers is only looking out for himself.

I will be working to make sure every Michigan voter understands just how
bad Mike Rogers would be for Michiganders if elected to the Senate, but we
need resources to start immediately holding him accountable to his record.

name: Tim Sheehy
subject: We’re losing steam
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA
body:
I have a meeting with President Trump on Friday afternoon, and I know he will ask me how much money I’m raising. |
---

Fellow American,

We’re losing steam at the worst possible time. While our campaign set a new fundraising record last month, the first five days of August have not been kind. **With just 91 days to Election Day, I find myself asking, why? **

**Is it because summer is nearing its end, and everyone is on vacation?

Is it because folks already think we have this race in the bag? Because I can assure you that we do not.

Or is it because you’re receiving far too many emails and text messages from people asking for money? **

Whatever the reason, we need our bad luck to turn around quickly. **[I have a meeting with President Trump on Friday afternoon in Montana, and I know he will ask about our fundraising numbers. The last three weeks of American news media has been dominated by Joe Biden withdrawing from reelection, Kamala Harris getting the Democratic nomination for President, and Tim Walz being tapped to run for Vice President. But critically, American media has comparatively ignored the ongoing genocide in Palestine, a genocide funded by U.S.tax dollars, and perpetuated by U.S. arms.
It is critical we do not look away. We instead must remain informed, aware, and educated on these atrocities--as only then can we have hope to stop these atrocities. Here are the crucial updates on the US funded genocide in Palestine that legacy media is refusing to center.
**Let 's Address This**.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b7620c21-3b9a-4443-94e5-3fe2bf5c8be4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

An injured child after an Israeli strike killed 30 Palestinian civilians in bombardment on the Hassan Salameh and Al-Nassr schools housing displaced Palestinians on August 4, 2024. (Photo by Omar AL-QATTAA / AFP) (AFP)
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=147427094&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ3NDI3MDk0LCJpYXQiOjE3MjMwNTAyMTgsImV4cCI6MTcyNTY0MjIxOCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.9-wgYGB-yFU8JxSvJIFAsXV30yHijOrwFx4XL9HbNpc)
### Death Toll Rises, Displacement, and Journalists Killed
While Gaza Health Ministry estimates of deaths are nearly 40,000, The Lancet applies a more comprehensive analysis to account for people indirectly killed by the siege on Gaza, and places that ghastly number of deaths at [186,000 Palestinians killed](https://substack.com/redirect/62cf3823-09a6-4288-82c5-74358ed5224a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The [Lancet reports](https://substack.com/redirect/62cf3823-09a6-4288-82c5-74358ed5224a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> In recent conflicts, such indirect deaths range from three to 15 times the number of direct deaths. Applying a conservative estimate of four indirect deaths per one direct death to the 37,396 deaths reported, it is not implausible to estimate that up to 186,000 or even more deaths could be attributable to the current conflict in Gaza.
Likewise, the UN estimates that 2 million Palestinians in Gaza have been displaced, [reporting](https://substack.com/redirect/59382195-94aa-4305-bfb0-e4473b1caff3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Around 1.9 million of Gaza's 2.1 million population - nine out of 10 people - are internally displaced, many multiple times. An estimated 43,580 are pregnant women. Each evacuation order upends lives, and in no place can survival be guaranteed. It also makes it more difficult for women and girls to access essential services, including the estimated 180 [women who give birth every day](https://substack.com/redirect/4ac76924-1e53-4081-86a2-18c6773a03d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
With the deliberate beheading murder of Palestinian journalist Ismail al-Ghoul, the Netanyahu regime has now [killed 165 journalists](https://substack.com/redirect/ec36fa3e-de4c-4103-b934-e9b29f98a607?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This is more journalists killed than in all other global conflicts _combined._ As the [Middle East Monitor reports](https://substack.com/redirect/ec36fa3e-de4c-4103-b934-e9b29f98a607?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Blast vests bearing the insignia "PRESS" protected their bodies. Minutes earlier they had updated the _Al Jazeera_ newsroom with their location. None of this would save their lives when an Israeli [drone strike blasted their car](https://substack.com/redirect/e481a1ce-9fe5-4eec-a3b5-174756f98c47?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The explosion blew off Al-Ghoul's head - an image subsequently shared on social media. Al-Refee and Khalid Shawa, a boy who happened to be passing by on a bicycle, also died instantly. Unusually, we know that the killing was deliberate - because the Israeli Defence Force (IDF) has [admitted as much](https://substack.com/redirect/8b4e2317-71ba-4905-9195-349123a80a01?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/117f45b3-066e-4c3c-a26c-1b0137e18724?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

### Polio, Torture, Rape, and Mass Graves
These human rights violations are simply staggering. And yet it gets worse. Health officials in Gaza have now detected polio in water supplies. This is due to a more than 10% drop in vaccination rates over the last year and underscores the severe public health crisis precipitated by this conflict. A vicious disease that had been eradicated is making a comeback as a direct result of this genocide. The World Health Organization [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/05061d0f-6a0c-4c1a-bab8-6f9c4ded3bc1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Now, children trapped in Gaza face this same threat [of polio] and are left with nowhere to turn. Prior to the conflict, vaccination coverage was at 99%. Now that rate has dropped to 86%, which is dangerous as this provides pockets of unvaccinated children, where the virus can circulate.
These figures are not just statistics; they represent countless lives shattered and dreams extinguished. Dreams of girls like Hind Rajab, the innocent 6-year-old girl who the IDF mercilessly murdered by shooting her [more than 335 times at close range](https://substack.com/redirect/e3a588aa-ae41-4932-9b40-0c6d8ec126c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Or of a young man named Muhammed Bhar, a sweet soul with Down syndrome, [brutally killed when the IDF mauled him to death with an attack dog](https://substack.com/redirect/355aeccb-5471-4624-9994-2fae7d22f38d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fd9d83b3-e129-4857-be59-6316fda43827?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A pro-Palestinian protester holds up a painted image of Hind Rajab during a demonstration in London in May 2024. (Credit: Mark Kerrison/In Pictures via Getty Images)
These are not isolated incidents but part of a systematic genocide. Adding to the outrage is [despite Biden's recognition that Netanyahu lied to him about wanting to get hostages released](https://substack.com/redirect/e21a4195-5300-41a8-b837-0d571527a56a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), he's continued to arm Netanyahu to bomb Palestinian civilians.
Last week Israelis violently rioted, [demanding the right to rape Palestinian prisoners](https://substack.com/redirect/8ac23e60-19e7-4084-b602-365dde3b1c80?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Far from rhetoric, this was the argument 'pro rape' Israelis made--that because accused Palestinians might be terrorists, any action against them is justified. These protests erupted after it came to light that Israeli soldiers are systemically raping Palestinian prisoners in a secret torture camp located in the desert. [Newly published video of the rape and torture is now making its rounds](https://substack.com/redirect/8bf3f93c-e4f4-405c-ab9a-2692f90f16b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (content warning).
Just as horrifying, this week the [Israeli military delivered the remains of 89 decaying Palestinian corpse](https://substack.com/redirect/fb2a6a4b-f12e-4e7b-ac03-4f64213c7fff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)s, without explanation. Authorities have no idea who these individuals are, how they died, or under for what justifiable reason they were mass murdered? And that's precisely the point--none of this is justifiable because genocide is never justified.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b5ca4a76-c463-43fc-8767-624c03bd52b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
People watch as bodies taken and later released by Israel are buried during a mass funeral in Khan Younis in southern Gaza [Bashar Taleb/AFP]
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..yvbYzL-MN8OLrOPNGtxEN697FEsgvqFUeyg1Dz_-EiQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=147427094)
### The Urgent Need to Enforce International and U.S. Law
The above is a brief nutshell of the ongoing atrocities being inflicted upon Palestinian civilians. It does not even begin to scratch the surface of Israel's numerous and ongoing bombings of schools, hospitals, and designated safe zones in Gaza. Keep in mind, [Hamas has long agreed to Israel's demands to release all hostages and commit to an immediate ceasefire](https://substack.com/redirect/e7660557-2e25-4963-afcc-155a47ea9105?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--but it is [the Israeli government itself that is refusing to agree to its own terms](https://substack.com/redirect/5fbfde23-c844-412d-b073-3b6655815504?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b48b82f3-8bc2-4aa9-87c4-03a4b8aca296?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The United States must urgently enforce international human rights law and the Leahy Laws, which prohibit U.S. assistance to foreign military units that commit gross human rights abuses. The genocide of Palestinians must be stopped, and those responsible held accountable. **The Harris/Walz ticket has an opportunity to end the current disastrous policies, and instead uphold justice.** They must not fail or delay to stop this genocide. We must invest in a future committed to justice and inclusion for all. Let us raise our voices to stop the genocide of Palestinians and ensure a future where every human being is treated with dignity and respect.
Each of us has a role to play. Advocate for policy changes, [contact your member of congress](https://substack.com/redirect/02d27ebe-cda7-4fdf-af8a-81cc7832c180?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), support human rights organizations, and educate others about the realities in Palestine. By coming together, we can make a difference and help build a world where justice prevails and every person's rights are upheld.
I will continue to keep you informed on these developments that legacy media refuses to center. Subscribe below and continue to elevate your voice for the sake of justice.

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2024_abs_em_slotkin.RQ4Ud0&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240807_AM1_V1_S1&t=1003&akid=7222%2E5257348%2ESDDmqS ]Throwback photo of Elissa Slotkin with her mom

Derek —

It’s official: I am the Democratic Nominee for the U.S. Senate in
Michigan. I know our campaign has sent a lot of emails your way, so I want
to take a few minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in
the first place, and why your support is so important in our success.

But if you’re ready to become a donor to our campaign right away you can
use this link:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2024_abs_em_slotkin.RQ4Ud0&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240807_AM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=7222%2E5257348%2ESDDmqS ]secure.actblue.com/donate/aug2024_abs_em_slotkin?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com

The truth is, we all know America is going through something right now. We
seem to be living from crisis to crisis. But there are certain things that
should be really simple:

Like living a middle-class life in the state that invented the middle
class.

Like making things in America so that we’re in control of our own economic
security.

Like protecting our children from the things that are truly harming them.

And preserving our rights and our democracy so that our kids can live
their version of the American dream.

I’m running for Senate because I believe that we need a new generation of
leaders that thinks differently, works harder, and never forgets that we
are public servants.

But my decision to run for Senate is also deeply personal to me, and it's
related to what motivated me to first run for the House in 2018.

It's about my mom. She was diagnosed with stage IV ovarian cancer in 2009
— and didn't have health insurance at the time. She had let it lapse after
the insurance companies had gouged her for years because she happened to
have a pre-existing condition. She passed away in 2011, but that
experience — of desperately trying to get her care at the same moment we
were filling out bankruptcy paperwork — motivated me to run then, and
keeps me motivated to fight now. I remember the exact moment that I
decided to enter public office: when the then-GOP controlled House of
Representatives, the body I now serve in, voted to repeal those
protections for people with pre-existing conditions.

Six years later, the Republican leaders, fueled by the extreme wing of the
party, are continuing the march to repeal things that the average
Americans want. They want to privatize Social Security and Medicare,
repeal drug price protections like allowing Medicare to negotiate; then
there are the rights they’re obsessed with repealing: a woman’s right to
choose, voting rights, and any possible gun safety legislation.

By winning this Senate seat, we’ll help ensure that Democrats retain the
(slight!) majority and can pass legislation that expands access to
healthcare. Not the obsession with taking things away.

To be upfront: Winning this race is going to take a lot of resources. A
crazy amount. And we have to do it without raising a single dollar from
corporate PACs.

Donations this November – when we’re in the home stretch – are important.
But donations now, as we enter the general election, are even more
important, because they allow us to map out a strategic plan and make
decisions about when and how we reach voters.

body:
It’s clear: Mike Rogers is only looking out for himself.

| Peter—

It’s official. I am the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate here in Michigan.

I’m so grateful to Michigan voters for entrusting me not only with this honor but also the responsibility of keeping Michigan and this U.S. Senate seat blue in November. I will not let you down.

Friend: When I was growing up, I never could have imagined that I'd run for elected office one day – let alone become the first computer programmer and the first former synagogue president ever elected to the Senate.
As the granddaughter of Jewish immigrants and the daughter of a World War II veteran, I was surrounded by loved ones who taught me the values of hard work, determination, and persistence – and I've carried these with me my entire life.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90391042/490354637/1398942472?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4195-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMDYyYmU5NC1lMDU0LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BeGdq9TfKBLcmDvXt2hXBlZc9a9FfH7SXBrB6lbgsbQ=)
I carried those values with me when I was working as a cocktail waitress at Caesars Palace to pay for college, becoming the first in my family to graduate. I carried them with me when I was working as a computer programmer in a male-dominated field.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90391043/490354638/1398942472?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4195-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMDYyYmU5NC1lMDU0LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BeGdq9TfKBLcmDvXt2hXBlZc9a9FfH7SXBrB6lbgsbQ=)
I carried those values with me during my first-ever campaign for Congress in 2016, when I flipped a highly competitive district from red to blue,**and in 2018, when I defeated a Republican incumbent against all odds – becoming the second woman senator in Nevada's history.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90391044/490354639/1398942472?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4195-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMDYyYmU5NC1lMDU0LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BeGdq9TfKBLcmDvXt2hXBlZc9a9FfH7SXBrB6lbgsbQ=)
To this day, those values of hard work, determination, and persistence fuel my fight to advocate for working families and bring much-needed progress to the lives of all Nevadans.
**But right now,_CNN_ is calling me the most vulnerable woman in the Senate – and _The Cook Political Report_ is calling Nevada the "most perilous" battleground for Democrats.**
The GOP will come after me with everything they've got, and I simply cannot fight back without your grassroots support. **[So please, friend, will you contribute $5 or more today to help me defend my seat and protect our Democratic Senate majority?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90391045/490354640/1398942472?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4195-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMDYyYmU5NC1lMDU0LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BeGdq9TfKBLcmDvXt2hXBlZc9a9FfH7SXBrB6lbgsbQ=)**

Friend —
It’s official. I am the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate here in Michigan.

I’m so grateful to Michigan voters for entrusting me not only with this honor, but also the responsibility of keeping Michigan and this U.S. Senate seat blue in November. I will not let you down.
Because there is just too much at stake:

Whether Michigan is a place where anyone can get in and stay in the middle class.

Whether our granddaughters have fewer rights than their grandmothers.

Whether the American experiment of a multi-racial, multi-ethnic democracy continues.

And whether Michigan contributes to keeping the White House, and making history.
So you can bet I will be working harder than I ever have before. I know that we can win this, but it will take all of us. My team has set a rather ambitious $100,000 General Election Founding Donor Goal for the next week so that we can hit the ground running in the sprint to the general election.[ Will you split a donation of $5 between Debbie Mucarsel-Powell and my campaign tonight and become a General Election Founding Donor?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90391544/490356610/1859387606?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk1687-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzgxMTk0ZjUtZTE1NC1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=MHS4fm_0-XiE5A5UfjZBUQZN2feRjyk3BtuK4ybTrIM=)

In short: the real race begins now, friend. We’re up against Donald Trump and Mitch McConnell’s handpicked candidate, Mike Rogers, a man who has shown that he’ll say or do anything to get elected.
He has co-sponsored bills that would not only ban abortion nationwide, but threaten in-vitro fertilization and birth control. He supported privatizing Social Security and Medicare. After 20 years as a politician, Rogers left Michigan for good. He cashed in on his D.C. connections to make millions by helping Chinese tech companies, giving them access to the United States. And in doing so, increased his net worth by as much as 2,000%. Then he bought a mansion in Florida and two yachts. He is only moving back to Michigan to run for the Senate.

The road to November starts right now. Peter, the results are in...

We just won our primary election!

This victory is a testament to the power of our grassroots movement and the incredible support from people, like you, who have been by my side every single step of the way.

From the bottom of my heart: Thank you for believing in me and for your unwavering dedication to our shared vision of a brighter future for every St. Louisan. Whether you’ve knocked on doors, made phone calls, shared our message, or donated — **your contributions have been pivotal in shaping the outcome of this election.**

I want to be clear: **This victory belongs to ALL of us.** I am profoundly grateful for your trust and commitment to me, this campaign, and creating a future for our district where nobody is left behind. _But our journey doesn’t end here._ With this primary win, the road to November begins NOW – which means that now, more than ever before, we need to ensure we’re prepared to take on the challenges that lie ahead.

Peter, I know that with you fighting alongside me we can – and will – overcome whatever obstacles are thrown our way. Our mission this November is simple: To restore integrity, compassion, and progress to Congress. Winning yesterday’s primary was only the beginning – I’m beyond ready to cross the finish line and bring real leadership back to MO-01. But, for today, I just want to say **thank you.**

Onward to November,

Friend, It’s unacceptable to me when people malign the meaning of patriotism and twist it to fit their needs. We know that MAGA extremists will do anything to try to win — including undermining our nation’s democracy as they did on January 6th. It’s especially unacceptable to me as a combat veteran who fought to protect our democracy —**because I know in my soul what real patriotism is.** Patriotism isn't about waving a flag around or dressing in red, white, and blue. It’s certainly **not** about using patriotism as an excuse to avoid fixing problems or **not** creating new opportunities for communities. **Patriotism is about unity.** Real patriotism means bringing people together. In the summer of 1990, Raul walked in the desert heat from business to business in the Coachella Valley asking them to invest in their community by contributing to his education. body:
Very big news — President Biden has promised to focus on cleaning up the Supreme Court during his final 5 months.
#
The corruption at the Supreme Court smells worse than a Pittsburgh construction site port-a-john on a hot summer day.
But it's now one big step closer to getting the deep clean it needs: President Joe Biden just published a serious op-ed in the Washington Post officially declaring his intent to bust out the metaphorical bleach.
President Biden has overseen more Supreme Court nominations as senator, vice president and president than anyone living today. **So when he says the current Court reeks of corruption, he knows what he's talking about.**
I'm proud to have the president's commitment to restore Americans' faith in our highest court.
**[Giving the Supreme Court a deep clean isn't a one-person job. Please pitch in $5 or whatever you can afford to fund the movement we're building to get it done.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240807?refcode=em20240807-9265&refcode2=9265_434096_eCLDxJ&akid=9265%2E434096%2EeCLDxJ)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240807?amount=5&refcode=em20240807-9265&refcode2=9265_434096_eCLDxJ&akid=9265%2E434096%2EeCLDxJ)**
President Biden is supporting some of the same reforms that I've called for, like:
1. Establishing term limits. The United States is the only major constitutional democracy that gives lifetime seats to its high court. It would greatly reduce any one president or party's ability to radically reshape the Court — like we saw Mitch McConnell and Donald Trump do in just 4 years.
2. Creating a binding code of conduct. SCOTUS's current code of ethics is only useful as toilet paper because it has no enforcement mechanism. If Clarence Thomas continues to accept undisclosed gifts from millionaires and billionaires with business before the Court, the only way to actually hold him accountable right now is impeachment. And as a senator, I believe we need more tools in our cleaning kit than that.

Between the connections to January 6th and accepting lavish gifts _without disclosing them_ — it's no wonder the MAGA Supreme Court's popularity with average Americans is in the shitter.
And yeah, I won't lie that thinking about how many 💩 jokes I can make in one email helps temper my anger about the truly brazen, historic corruption we've seen.
**But at the end of the day, Americans deserve and need to be able to trust that the highest court in the land serves _their_ interests, not whoever is funding Clarence Thomas's next vaca.**
**[This isn't a 1-day clean up job. This is going to take months if not years — and we need a president, Senate, and House that will get it done. Pitch in $5 to help do just that.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240807?refcode=em20240807-9265&refcode2=9265_434096_eCLDxJ&akid=9265%2E434096%2EeCLDxJ)**
❤️ John
John Fetterman
U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20240807-9265-footer&t=1&refcode2=9265_434096_eCLDxJ&akid=9265%2E434096%2EeCLDxJ)**

The United States is the only major constitutional democracy that gives lifetime seats to its high court. It would greatly reduce any one president or party's ability to radically reshape the Court — like we saw Mitch McConnell and Donald Trump do in just 4 years. 2. Creating a binding code of conduct. SCOTUS's current code of ethics is only useful as toilet paper because it has no enforcement mechanism. If Clarence Thomas continues to accept undisclosed gifts from millionaires and billionaires with business before the Court, the only way to actually hold him accountable right now is impeachment. And as a senator, I believe we need more tools in our cleaning kit than that. Between the connections to January 6th and accepting lavish gifts without disclosing them — it's no wonder the MAGA Supreme Court's popularity with average Americans is in the shitter. And yeah, I won't lie that thinking about how many 💩 jokes I can make in one email helps temper my anger about the truly brazen, historic corruption we've seen. But at the end of the day, Americans deserve and need to be able to trust that the highest court in the land serves their interests, not whoever is funding Clarence Thomas's next vaca. ❤️ John John Fetterman U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania | | Email us: info@johnfetterman.com

I grew up in a working class neighborhood in mid-Missouri. Like so many other Americans, my family lived paycheck-to-paycheck. So when my little sister was born with a heart condition, the medical bills bankrupted us. Maxed-out credit cards and no money left, times had never been tougher.
But we weren’t alone — our community took care of us. When my parents had to take my sister to the hospital in St. Louis, our neighbors and friends took my siblings and me into their homes and brought more meals by the house than we could ever hope to eat. **That’s the Missouri I grew up in.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/65724?refcode=em20240807-7274&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=7274%2E614464%2E0Uc--z)
Their support helped send me to college, and after that I joined the Marines to honor everything they had done for me and my family growing up. Got deployed to Iraq and Afghanistan. Later the Pentagon. I was on the Joint Staff negotiating arms control agreements with NATO and Russia.
When I came home between tours in Iraq and Afghanistan, one of the hardest things was seeing what was happening back in my old neighborhood. It was a community picked for parts — the local corner store boarded up, my first family house bulldozed to the ground. **Here’s all that’s left of it:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/65724?refcode=em20240807-7274&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=7274%2E614464%2E0Uc--z)
While all of us were risking our lives building up towns like Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Herat, career politicians like Josh Hawley let our country waste away. They spent trillions on bailouts, tax breaks, and subsidies for the industries that stripped our communities for parts — like Wall Street, Big Pharma, and Big Oil — and then told us they can’t figure out how to invest even a fraction of that into building up our own country and investing in our own people.
**I saw what was happening — and I was ready to fight back.**
So in my final year of active duty, I worked to upend the corporate defense monopolies that leave our country less safe. I also joined an organization that fights corporate monopolies — we took on defense contractors, Big Pharma, Big Tech, Big Ag, Wall Street. The people buying off our politicians and leaving the rest of us behind.
**And now, I’m running for U.S. Senate to replace Josh Hawley and fundamentally change who has power in our country** — to put everyday people in charge of their own bodies, families, and lives. I want to abolish corporate PACs, expose lobbyists writing our laws, criminalize war profiteering, ban insider trading among members of Congress, and enact a Marshall Plan for the Midwest — a massive investment and job creation program that will rebuild our forgotten communities and get us off fossil fuels once and for all.
I want to end Missouri’s total abortion ban, codify Roe v. Wade, secure voting rights, and ban anti-union “Right-to-Work” scams forever. I want to put working people in charge of our country. But I need your help to get it done.
**Without a single cent of corporate PAC money, we’re building the people-powered movement that’s going to defeat Josh Hawley and flip this Senate seat — and I need you on our team to get it done.[Will you please make a donation of any amount toward my campaign right now so we can start the general election off strong and take back power for real Missourians this November?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/65724?refcode=em20240807-7274&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=7274%2E614464%2E0Uc--z)**

clean_body: The Midwestern dad is gaining popularity. Conservatives are terrified. Peter, On Tuesday, Vice President Kamala Harris announced her running mate – Minnesota Governor Tim Walz. A slew of politicians, from progressive Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez to Senator Joe Manchin to Republicans like Maryland Senate candidate Larry Hogan, came out in support of Walz. But most Republicans are in attack mode, rushing to define Walz as a radical left-winger. Peter, things are starting to get weird. = Walz, a former coach and teacher, has quickly won support from across the political spectrum because of his achievements as the popular governor of Minnesota, including providing free lunches for all Minnesota public school students, codifying abortion rights into state law, and allowing all residents to get driver’s licenses. He’s also the guy who famously described Donald Trump and JD Vance as “weird” and out of touch with the American mainstream. To Republicans, of course, that means Tim Walz is the next great liberal bogeyman. And they’re willing to lie like crazy to get voters to believe that. Here’s some of the weird attacks Fox News and the MAGA right are testing on the news and social media: Turning Point USA co-founder Charlie Kirk called Walz’s popular policies “radical,” claiming he turned Minnesota into a “war zone.” Stephen Miller took to One America News to call Walz “Tampon Tim,” the now-popular attack on the governor who passed legislation to put free menstrual products in school bathrooms. Jesse Watters questioned why Walz and his wife spent their honeymoon in China, claiming he was “being groomed by the Chinese.” Greg Gutfeld went for the looks attack on Fox News, calling Walz “a male Karen with a pot belly.” The attacks range from stupid to weird to downright lies. But what’s new? Here’s the thing, Peter: Walz isn’t a radical – he’s a dad, an educator, and an effective Governor who just so happens to be a Democrat. And the right is scared that voters will see all that. So they’re doing what they always do by throwing spaghetti at the wall to see what sticks. Here at COURIER, we’re ready to fight back against right-wing election lies and fear-mongering by calling out Fox News and the MAGA right in real-time. name: Carmen Goers
subject: Carmen Goers Advances to the General Election
body:
| | | | | | | |
---
| | | |
---
| | | **Carmen Goers Advances to the General Election****!**
---

**Puyallup, WA** ... Carmen Goers was sent forward to the general election with 44.27 percent of the vote. Carmen declared her candidacy for the 8th Congressional District back in February of 2023 and since then has earned the endorsements of over 55 locally elected officials and unions.

Carmen had this to say about the results _“I am grateful for the people of the 8th Congressional District. Tonight is a night of celebration and with your help we will celebrate again in November_ ”.

Speaking to a crowd of supporters at the Pierce County Republican Party watch party, Carmen had this to say about the primary race _“As Republicans we worked hard to avoid a primary fight, and that hard work paid off tonight”_ Goers continued by saying _“We’ve had three terms of failed leadership from our current congresswoman. In two of those terms, she was in the majority and couldn’t help curve inflation, help our farmers, stop a growing crime pandemic, or even provide resources to our officers. In fact, she did the exact opposite by voting against our law enforcement officers, our small businesses, and the communities she claims to represent. We need a change and I’m excited to work with you to bring that change to our district and state. I want to thank everyone who voted in the primary.”_ Goers said.

Justus Phelps, Campaign Manager said _ “These results show that the voters are ready for a change. While we are celebrating tonight, we also know that there is a lot more work ahead. Carmen Goers was able to stave off a Republican challenger, allowing her to work on meeting voters where they are. We’ve touched almost every community in the 8th Congressional District, and if we haven’t been to a community yet we are working on getting her there”_ added Phelps.

November 5th is the next election, more information on Carmen can be found by visiting her website [CarmenforWashington.com](https://vgq.soundestlink.com/ce/c/652845d9aa222127cf458b43/66b3b7256c275699a3c34b2d/66b3b73e1de99acd5a576f26?signature=da515f0682e49b9a10a9cdc5f2930ca30405a4867b655471af2494d01fef1369).

body:
...But it made me a Congresswoman instead.

| |

---
| | | My restaurant almost landed me in jail - but it made me a Congresswoman instead.

My name is Lauren Boebert. Before serving in Congress, I was serving hungry Coloradans as the owner of Shooters Grill in Rifle, Colorado. As a die-hard defender of our Right to Bear Arms, I encouraged my staff to open carry at work. Liberals hated me for it.

A few years later, I made even more headlines when I defied power hungry politicians during COVID and opened up my restaurant anyway. **They sued me. They tried to close my doors forever. And they made me an enemy of the state.**

_But I 'm a mama bear of 4 boys - it takes a LOT more than a few empty suits to scare me!_

I'm tough. And now that I'm in Congress, I'm not afraid to ruffle some feathers and speak my mind. I'll never stop fighting for President Trump, my faith, my country, or our God-given rights.

Unfortunately, defeating Kamala Harris, defending our freedoms, and saving our country will be EXPENSIVE. Biden handed over his 91 million dollar warchest on day one AND the Democrat Machine raised another 200 million bucks when Kamala was coronated. _**[That's why I'm teaming up with Majority Leader Steve Scalise to raise a million dollars from this email alone to help.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=220c4d4815654690a885a82bd11b9378&_e=yJPc1BI8GUeI5eIf389Ok532jSwHRmQ3b1MlihhDnt7u5CTcKtrihyDtEtyxwJ5k6jRO1VtJOB4aUehmGwG9ZRlAFAYng77qiWGy-VrcaveSnAm4-Akrf4OdbXevD7Mh4PwJc2K6XX6mCVGRpf-_NxRGw5nBGq1QRP4saIt38-qdHWbO7LhIldofuKuZvVtb6tsux_NyOnw6LNYAFSLbL_CWLeiUZ5lIF9iYg0gIDOdm40uZloiIYDx8aA8Vot-NhJJO7a11uAqNzkkR_mfhURxboGIrJhWJJczvTNJEVES5r3E58GP2XkW90KCyIg3AkllfwRO7g1B9j3A7LcjNgYBKlYIA6w2oDPb3OurxsF7NHI56BqmuWfluuIyS1LlBLndBqnq5j8a-bZjeUc5AJcvsf8D5loZNQq_c3Hi5LaXHg_hYerk-iArhoLtSemCtbl6-nwvw2CcuGbb0hZrlow%3D%3D "That’s why I’m teaming up with Majority Leader Steve Scalise to raise a million dollars from this email alone to help. Now that Kari Lake is officially our opponent, we have to be ready for anything.
#

Peter -
$5.
That’s the donation we’re asking you to make today to help Ruben Gallego take back Arizona’s seat in the U.S. Senate his November.
More than 250,000 people have chipped in so far. 250,000 people doing what they can to defend our Senate majority, defeat Kari Lake, and keep Trump out of the White House. That’s something we’re very proud of, and it’s made a huge impact.
But now that Kari Lake is officially our opponent, we have to be ready for anything. We’re moving ahead to Election Day, and we have to make the most of every moment between now and then.
Trump knows how important this race is, too. That’s why he’s backing Kari Lake with everything he’s got, and it’s why he attacked Ruben directly at a rally last week. He needs Arizona if he’s going to have any chance at winning back the White House, and if Ruben wins, it’s all the more likely Trump loses.

#
Friend of Life,

Planned Parenthood just came out with a new video that calls virginity "made up" and a "social construct."

The "educator" in the video tells young people: "It's time to throw away the notion of losing your virginity."

Instead of seeing it as "losing something," Planned Parenthood encourages impressionable teens to experiment sexually because "all of these myths around sex and virginity can be so hurtful and overwhelming."

Planned Parenthood is grooming the next generation for abortion. Promoting risky sexual practices to young people ultimately leads them to broken relationships and more children killed in the womb.

**Will you help fight back against Planned Parenthood 's anti-family, pro-death agenda? I'm asking 50 people to step forward today with a $50 gift to help us put our life-saving videos into classrooms nationwide**. **[https://give.liveaction.org/stop-planned-parenthood-mms/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=d5a592a4ee0a463c9b70aacced8a923c&_e=DDGw_xPvNQYgMBAZSD1cwvqyjiFu4BNDu0sGQVvQJ9c2Uc11na1dqiN-Uq74XVGjJovZr8HSMpHee16gKLYVbnK95P2ETlqralK_XU2CHCX2zvD7fY45WzuZM0HLdJmNejG7vFHfNjqT1SbHRh1caS318Qusp7vZZ9nsXObGvhiTRT5wg9CZZurmPsiP98mtQqmOkurXZmX2TasUIJUfbgPfQJM2AR7ZRbPvdKRklyj3MLOuitwJPA6GZpet9tFqWGo0TusltuR-AGaEe5wXEY6RwxSLYmPmB50ABPa-P3eSXUEuMLnK1W5_XK1Dwzky12bMyJmyRNmQbY6vwrqO4yla1CE9iIWga8YkSjj33Pc%3D)**

Planned Parenthood has continuously pushed egregious and pornographic materials in schools to young kids and teens -- and what do they "teach" these impressionable kids about sex? That disturbing practices are "normal" and "healthy."

In classic Planned Parenthood fashion, irrefutable definitions are warped, and morality is thrown out the window.

Planned Parenthood is the largest provider of sex education in America -- and they teach kids that gender is fluid, deviant sexual practices are normal and healthy, and anything goes, as long as it's consensual.

**We need to protect our children against Planned Parenthood 's deception. This deadly organization should not be the educator of our children. **

Friend of Life, this is why we at Live Action have been creating - and are about to release! - wholesome sex-ed video series for schools across the country to use instead of Planned Parenthood's damaging materials.

We need to spread the truth about loving relationships between men and women and the beauty of procreation before the next generation of parents is convinced by Planned Parenthood's disturbing agenda that leads to abortion.

**But we can 't complete this critical initiative without your support. Your gift of $50 will help us complete the videos and get them into schools across the country. Your partnership gives me so much hope. I can't wait to share the impact your activism will have in months to come. Our children - and grandchildren - depend on it.

For Life,

Lila Rose

Here are the Seven Deadly Sins of the Biden, Harris and Himes Administration:
1. _**First - They Came For Our Freedom With Unreasonable Lockdowns**_
2. _**Second - They Took Away Our Affordable Energy**_
3. _**Third - They Came After Our Children**_
4. _**Fourth - They Opened the Border to Everyone Including Terrorists, Criminals, Gang Members, Drug Dealers, Child and Sex Traffickers**_
5. _**Fifth - They Have Turned Our Healthcare System Into a Bureaucratic Overpriced System Where Patients, Doctors and Other Healthcare Providers Don 't Matter**_
6. _**Sixth - They Have Legitimized Antisemitic Riots and Physical Assaults Against Jews and Jewish Institutions**_
7. _**Seventh - Crime Pays**_

**We must reverse course and repeal the policies that have wrecked havoc with America.**
**On August 13 th, Stand up for America and Our Future and the Future of Our Children and VOTE GOLDSTEIN ON AUGUST 13 so I can take on Jim Himes and solidify a team of Connecticut State Reps and Senators that support me and what we have been doing to build a strong bench for November's title fight. VOTE FOR ME ON ROW B. - Early Voting is available Now so check your local Registrar of Voters.**
I would be honored by your support and tell your friends to get out and vote.
**Dr. Michael Goldstein**
[ Pledge your support](https://substack.._KlNYQc2Qe4mGQ4D02tXFYFFWDoABSAxgYAJlknu-zg?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=147458933)
If You Want to Read On in Detail These 7 Deadly Sins Are expanded upon below:
**First They Came For Our Freedom With Unreasonable Lockdowns**
During the COVID Pandemic there was panic and fear of massive deaths. In response to that fear we surrendered our liberties and we were abused. Our lives were restricted beyond what was necessary. Businesses were either classified as essential and remained open or non essential and shut down. Houses of Worship were closed and liquor stores remained open. Vaccine mandates were arbitrarily imposed. There was no open scientific discourse regarding the pros and cons of vaccine policy regarding the medical necessity of every age group being vaccinated without any risk analysis. Dissention was censored. There was huge misinformation, including the fact that vaccines gave total immunity, when it did not, and that vaccinated people could not transmit COVID to others when they could . Vaccine immunity proved to be short lived, requiring frequent boosters. Individuals who had natural immunity should not have needed to be vaccinated. Those who resisted, lost their jobs, were ostracized and were mislabeled as radicals. Vaccines did play a beneficial role especially in the elderly, the sick and nursing home populations. More sophisticated risk benefit analysis, including the risk of myocarditis, should have been done in the younger populations. The lessons to be learned are not to give up our liberty so freely, to take it back as quickly as possible and to make healthcare policy based on scientific facts, where all sides of the issue have a fair chance to be heard.
**Second They Took Away Our Affordable Energy**
Almost immediately after Biden took office his radical changes in our energy policy caused the price of gasoline to almost triple, the price of heating oil tripled and natural gas prices rose significantly. High electric prices soon followed. High grocery prices and consumer prices followed suit. But team Biden including Himes did nothing to stop the economic harm caused by these skyrocketing energy costs. In fact their only solution is for us to buy overpriced solar panels mostly made in China with huge government subsidies paid for by taxpayers and electric utility rate payers. Many people are struggling to make ends meet and many are going into debt thanks to bad policies. Our nuclear power plants are from the 1970's and we need new cost effective mini-nuclear power plants. Access to enough cheap natural gas are blocked by federal laws that need to be changed. None of this pain had to happen. Let's return to affordable energy and increased domestic production rather than import higher priced oil from dictators
T**hird They Came After Our Children**
During the pandemic schools were closed for too long. Education became more political the focused on the skills necessary to function in a 21st Century economy. Schools have become more like indoctrination centers. Parental rights are being taken away and when parents protest they are labeled domestic terrorist. Puberty blocking hormones which cause irreversible harm have been banned in the UK and are being given without parental knowledge or consent. Children in minority districts are given substandard educations not because of the amount spent on education but instead because of poorly run schools. School choice and voucher programs are needed so that education becomes competitive and parents have better options for their children's future than a failing school system.
**Fourth They Opened the Border to Everyone Including Terrorists, Criminals, Gang Members, Drug Dealers, Child and Sex Traffickers**
It is believed that 20 million illegals have entered the country. We are supporting many of them with free housing, free food, free clothing, free medical care, spending allowances and free education for their children. They are doing better than some of our veterans and many working class citizens. This makes no sense and we the taxpayers are footing the bill. No country in the world besides us is letting this happen. Crime is up, taxes to pay for this are up and we are sending the message that crime pays. The real end game is to make these illegals citizens so that with your tax dollars you are creating a voter block that will ensure that those who do not act in our best interests get elected.
**Fifth They Have Turned Our Healthcare System Into a Bureacratic Overpriced System Where Patients, Doctors and Other Healthcare Providers Don 't Matter**
Medical care is about a patient seeing their doctor or other healthcare provider for the purpose of curing them through treatment or surgery or managing a chronic illness to improve quality of life and longevity. The doctor is supposed to be the patient advocate fighting for what is best for the patient. In the new world the doctor works for the hospital which is more focused on economics than patient interest. Patients can no longer easily contact their doctor except through a patient portal. Patients who need urgent but not emergency care do not have easy ways to schedule urgent appointments and are forced to go to Urgent Care Centers who do not have access to the patient's medical center and often do not have a physician, physician's assistant or nurse practitioner who has the specific expertise to manage specialty based medical problems. Or the go to an emergency room where they will spend hours, go through many processes that have nothing to do with their urgent issue and waste healthcare dollars on this very expensive process. Healthcare needs to reverse course and return its focus on the patient and prioritizing cost effective quality care over bureaucratic regulations and institutional roadblocks. In the end this will reduce costs and improve quality.
**Sixth They Have Legitimized Antisemitic Riots and Physical Assaults Against Jews and Jewish Institutions**
Never in recent American history have we seen antisemitic riots that turn violent, destroy property and physical violence against Jews. All of this is being tolerated because the protesters are democrat voters who are needed to win elections in swing states. This is morally repulsive and this hate will escalate. Jews will be the first victims but never the last. There are paid agitators and non citizens participating in these riots. The paid agitators should be arrested and the non citizens should be deported. When these protests violate the law there needs to be arrests and prosecutions. That is not happening in the Biden, Harris, Himes world.
**Seventh Crime Pays**
In the upside world of the Biden, Harris and Himes team the criminals are the victims and the victims are not entitled to justice. There have been violent criminals who are released after arrest and commit additional violent crimes. Finally when they are caught committing murder they are finally arrested. How many lives have been lost due these policies. Shoplifting can put stores out of business and at the least cause stores to raise prices. But somehow the shoplifters are victims. To make matters worse they want to defund the police, they have removed qualified immunity which puts a police officer at risk for doing their job.
**All of the Harmful and Destructive Polices of the Biden , Harris and Himes Team Need to Be Reversed**
Lockdowns must never happen again. The economic survival of many Americans is dependent on restoring affordable energy. Parental rights and school choice will ensure a brighter future for our children. The borders must be closed, the criminals must be deported and we must defund illegal aliens. Patients must come first and bureaucracy must be cut back to lower costs and improve care. Physician and other healthcare professionals cannot continue to work in an environment that is causing widespread burnout. Antisemitic riots and unpunished violations of our Civil Rights and criminal laws must come to an end. Criminals must be prosecuted the power of the police to enforce the law must return.
**I am running for Congress to join the fight to bring back the America that existed before all of the harmful policies of the Biden, Harris and Himes team were implemented. We must fight back now before it is too late.**
**I need your vote starting today in early voting and on August 13th in the Republican Primary. AND EARLY VOTING IS GOING ON THROUGH SUNDAY AUGUST 11.**
